jobs.title: Liquid Systems Sustaining Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Liquid Systems Sustaining Engineering Manager

Job Description:

The Role: Sustaining Engineering Manager 

Entegris is seeking an experienced and motivated Sustaining Engineering Manager to lead the global sustaining engineering organization supporting products within the Fluid Handling and Liquid Packaging Strategic Business Units (SBUs). This position may be located at either our Jangan, Korea or Munmak, Korea site and will be part of the Liquid Systems organization. 


The manager will lead a team of global engineers responsible for sustaining engineering activities across manufacturing sites in Korea, and Taiwan. The team provides technical leadership for released products, drives product and process improvements, resolves field and manufacturing issues, supports quality and reliability initiatives, and helps ensure continuity of supply for Entegris' portfolio of high-purity fluid handling and liquid packaging products supporting the semiconductor industry. 

 

This role requires a strong technical leader with demonstrated experience managing geographically dispersed engineering teams and leading cross-functional efforts involving Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Management, and New Product Development organizations. 

 

In this role you will:  

Provide technical and organizational leadership for all global sustaining engineering activities related to released products within the Fluid Handling and Liquid Packaging SBUs. Establish priorities, develop technical talent, and drive consistent execution of sustaining engineering processes across global manufacturing locations. Serve as the primary engineering escalation point for product performance, reliability, quality, cost improvement, and continuity-of-supply initiatives. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead, coach, and develop a global team of sustaining engineers located across Korea, and Taiwan. 
  • Own the technical support strategy for released products throughout their lifecycle. 
  • Drive structured root cause investigations and corrective actions related to customer complaints, field failures, quality concerns, and manufacturing issues. 
  • Partner with global manufacturing sites to improve product yield, quality, throughput, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
  • Lead product improvement initiatives focused on performance, reliability, cost reduction, and manufacturability. 
  • Support business continuity by identifying and mitigating product, process, supplier, and manufacturing risks. 
  • Provide engineering leadership for product transfers, alternate-source qualifications, supplier changes, and manufacturing process improvements. 
  • Lead engineering assessments related to product obsolescence, material changes, regulatory requirements, and end-of-life management. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Quality organizations to support customer engagements, technical problem resolution, and product stewardship activities. 
  • Support manufacturing plants during audits, customer visits, qualification activities, and significant production challenges. 
  • Ensure appropriate engineering support for change-control activities, including Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and Management of Change (MOC) processes. 
  • Partner with New Product Development teams to incorporate lessons learned from manufacturing, customers, and field performance into future product designs. 
  • Develop and manage sustaining engineering metrics, project portfolios, staffing plans, budgets, and resource priorities. 
  • Drive standardization, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices across the global engineering organization. 
  • Build and maintain a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction. 

 

Traits we believe make a strong candidate: 

  • Proven technical and organizational leadership experience within a global engineering environment. 
  • Demonstrated success leading sustaining engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or operations engineering teams. 
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause investigation skills using structured methodologies. 
  • Experience supporting released products through quality, reliability, manufacturing, and customer-facing challenges. 
  • Ability to lead geographically distributed teams and influence stakeholders across functions and regions. 
  • Strong background in product lifecycle management, change management, and sustaining engineering processes. 
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality systems, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience supporting products used in highly controlled and quality-sensitive industries is preferred. 
  • Experience with high-purity fluid handling, polymer components, semiconductor consumables, packaging, or related technologies is preferred. 
  • Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and interpersonal skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while balancing immediate business needs with long-term strategic objectives. 
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to align technical decisions with organizational goals. 
  • Demonstrated commitment to coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering talent. 

 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred. 
  • Minimum of 10 years of engineering experience supporting manufacturing, product development, product engineering, or sustaining engineering activities. 
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams. 
  • Experience leading global or multi-site engineering organizations is preferred. 
  • Strong English communication skills; Korean language proficiency is preferred. 

 

Work Location and Travel 

Position is based on-site in Korea at either the Jangan or Munmak facility. 

Domestic and international travel is required to support manufacturing operations, customers, suppliers, and engineering teams in Korea, Taiwan, and the United States.

jobs.title: Manager, Analytics & Metrology
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Manager, Analytics & Metrology

Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY 

Entegris is seeking an Analytical Lab Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, strategic planning and technical projects of our Analytical Lab in Oseong, KR. In line with our PACE values, you will collaborate cross-functionally with technicians, scientists, engineers, leadership, sales, marketing and global technical teams to provide high quality, reliable data to the manufacturing team and other stakeholders.  

 

What you’ll do: 

  • Ensure lab has the proper resources and processes to report data accurately and timely to meet factory production schedules 
  • Instill safety culture in team to meet goal of zero recordable injuries.  
  • Recruit and hire new team members.   
  • Provide feedback, mentor and develop team members to help them meet their career goals.  
  • Provide training and training plans for team members.  
  • Work with Quality team to ensure all quality best practices are being implemented.  LTS, SPC charts and MSA requirements are tracked and completed on time.  
  • Meet instrument uptime goals by ensuring we have the necessary trouble shooting skills, we provide timely maintenance, and PMs are completed on time.   
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Quality, Engineering, Operations, and R&D teams to support analytical requests and transition new products into production environment. 
  • Provide technical support to CQE, MQE, Product Managers and other customer facing teams 
  • Manage lab expenses to meet plant budgetary goals.  
  • Develop processes to improve lab capacity, efficiency, and reduce waste 
  • Support audits (internal and external) as needed. 
  • Assist in Strategic Long-Range Planning to support factory 5-year roadmap. 
  • This role is on-site in Oseong factory and supports 24x7 manufacturing facility. 

 

What we seek: 

  • Bachelor of Science in chemistry, physics or engineering or related field required, M.S. or Ph.D. preferred. 
  • At least 5 years of relevant operational laboratory management experience as well as additional years of hands-on laboratory experience 
  • Solid knowledge of analytical chemistry, materials science & physics required.   Familiarity with semiconductor device materials, structures, and metrology preferred. 
  • Working knowledge of lab instruments operations and analysis. (HPLC, IC, GC, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, FTIR, Raman, particle sizing instruments)  
  • Ability to create and manage project plans and timelines, define project deliverables, assign project team roles and resources, identify and track issues and their resolution, and manage project scope, creep, and requirements. 
  • Familiarity with Good Lab Practices and Good Manufacturing Practices 
  • Proficient in data analysis, statistical methods, and quality management systems.  
  • Knowledge of proper controls for analytical instrumentation, SPC, stability, accuracy, variation, and method uncertainty and GR&R required. 
  • Understands customer quality requirements and expectations and works to meet those goals. 
  • Hands on experience with applicable quality tools such as pareto, FMEA’s, SPC/SQC, histograms, trend analysis, process mapping, design of experiments, cause and effect diagrams, 8D problem solving methodology required. 
  • Ability to wear the required PPE when working in the labs (safety glasses, face shields, lab coat, steel toe boots, cleanroom garments etc.) 
  • Prior experience managing people and working w/ global teams 
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in from all stakeholders. 
  • Strong project management skills, organizational skills, and written and verbal communication skills are required. 
  • Flexible, internally driven individual that can support fast paced, constantly changing environment and a multitude of priorities 
  • Ability to travel occasionally. Max 1x per quarter.  

 

An Outstanding candidate will have: 

  • Knowledge of LIMS applications (Labware, SampleManager) 
  • Knowledge of software systems used in analytical laboratories (Chromeleon, OpenLab, etc) 
  • Good working Knowledge of ISO 17025, and 90001 standards.   
  • Prior experience managing laboratory services in a chemical manufacturing environment.  
  • Familiarity with handling corrosives and air-sensitive chemistries (liquid and solid materials) in support of three major product lines (Deposition, Cleans and CMP).

jobs.title: Lead, Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Lead, Product Manager

Job Description:

The Role


Entegris is currently seeking a Lead, Product Manager to join our Specialty Gas team, based in our Danbury, CT or JangAn, Korea facility. 

Lead Product Manager to own an assigned Specialty Gases portfolio. The role leads product strategy, roadmaps, pricing, forecasting, sourcing, commercialization, and lifecycle management. Acting as a central cross-functional resource, the Lead Product Manager applies business and technical expertise to resolve complex issues, influence stakeholders, and deliver revenue, margin, market-share, and customer objectives.


Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Deliver global revenue, gross margin, market-share, and operating targets for assigned product lines; monitor performance and lead corrective actions.
  • Support 8D investigations and related quality activities, ensuring timely follow-through and effective resolution.
  • Deliver portfolio and project milestones on time and within budget, including business documentation for capital, new-product, sustaining, and reporting initiatives.
  • Define and execute product strategy, including roadmaps, partnerships, commercialization priorities, pricing, positioning, product changes, and lifecycle decisions.
  • Partner with sales, distributors, and strategic partners to expand market access, strengthen sales readiness, and translate customer needs into product plans.
  • Develop financial models and business cases to support pricing, investment, roadmap, and new-product decisions.
  • Lead cross-functional decisions and initiatives with R&D, Engineering, Finance, Manufacturing, Quality, Field Applications, EH&S, Legal, Supply Chain, Logistics, Marketing, and Sales.
  • Develop demand forecasts with documented assumptions, opportunities, constraints, and risks; align capacity, inventory, backlog, and customer commitments with Operations and Supply Chain.Lead product governance from concept through post-launch optimization, including stage-gate decisions, launch readiness, risk mitigation, performance tracking, product changes, quality escalations, and lifecycle trade-offs.
  • Represent the voice of the customer and sales by converting market intelligence, competitive insight, and customer feedback into value propositions, product requirements, and priorities that support market-share growth.
  • Create and present customer-facing and sales-enablement materials, including presentations, data sheets, proposals, training, and supporting collateral for global commercial teams.
  • Provide product management expertise and coach colleagues and cross-functional teams in effective business decision-making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including P&L drivers, cost structures, gross margin, forecasting, ROI, NPV, total cost of ownership, and business-case development.
  • Ability to work independently on complex issues, evaluate variable factors, exercise judgment in selecting methods, and develop effective approaches for new assignments.
  • Proven ability to influence up, down, and across the organization and guide cross-functional action without direct authority. 
  • Ability to synthesize customer, market, operational, technical, and sales input into clear recommendations, product priorities, and growth actions.
  • Strong customer presence and communication skills across executive presentations, technical discussions, proposals, product reviews, and stakeholder inquiries.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of semiconductor processes, technology, materials, customer applications, and relevant operational and supply-chain considerations. 
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities, anticipate risk, and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Engineer II, Systems Engineering

Job Description:

  •  Responsible for Control System which including design, specify, commission and provide project management for local instrumentation and control systems supporting production and utility systems used in batch & continuous specialty chemical manufacturing operations.
  • The current application environment includes Rockwell/Allen Bradley PLCs (ControlLogix and CompactLogix Systems) on a DeviceNet/Ethernet infrastructure, as well as, GE software packages, such as, iFIX and iHistorian. Knowledge and experience in programming GE Proficy software suites, such as, Real Time Information Portal, Plant Application, Workflow, etc. would be an advantage too. (experience with other PLC platforms such as LS Electric and Omron is also beneficial).
  • Also, knowledge and experience in Visual Basic, SQL Query development, Rockwell/Allen Bradley Powerflex VFDs, and industrial DeviceNet/Ethernet network design would be a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Instrumentation, Electrical, PLC, and other control systems' support

  • The person will be responsible for configuring and programming of the PLC’s, data historian systems, operator interface or HMI screens, as well as, developing the scope, instrument specifications, procurement requisitions, installation, and commissioning of all the instrumentation and control systems equipment globally.
  • These activities include seeking and adapting new technology to increase quality, safety, productivity, and efficiency in manufacturing and pilot plants through increased automation levels.

Maintain & improve existing instrumentation, PLC, and control systems at local sites

  • Maintain control systems equipment, software, and hardware through direct involvement and setting up resources such as outside contractors, training other maintenance and operations personnel, etc. 
  • A close coordination with operations, process engineers, production engineers, and maintenance personnel will be required for the routine support to the plants.

OT Network & Cybersecurity Management

  • Manage OT network infrastructure including Ethernet/IP, VLAN, and managed switches configurations.
  • Perform OT security management using tools such as Tenable OT (asset inventory, vulnerability scanning, policy compliance).
  • Troubleshoot communication issues between PLC/HMI/SCADA/Historian systems and ensure secure, stable data flow.

Improvement to existing automation level in manufacturing

  • Provides innovative & creative ideas, and seek out opportunities to introduce automation to the routine activities in manufacturing and pilot plants.
  • Determines the best control strategy for existing and new systems/processes.

Expert advice to various groups on modern control systems and process data systems

  • Plays a lead role in answering the questions and resolving the concerns related to process data systems, including help to various groups to interpret and understand the manufacturing data.
  • Champions the changes (capital or non-capital) to improve performance in these areas

Key knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Business - Scope development, design, scheduling, project management, and commissioning of assigned projects, both, independently and with the help of engineering firms.
  • Good communication skills. 
  • Ability to meet deadlines by project or production requirement to solve problem.
  • Be capable of managing several tasks/projects simultaneously. 
  • Gathers and interprets customer (internal) functional requirements and re-interprets them to prepare functional control descriptions for Control System programmers.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and shift previously established priorities in response to changing business needs.
  • Works in a collaborative manner with production management, process engineers, production engineers, quality engineers, IT engineers, and others.
  • There will be local travel for several days at a time.
  • Ability to drive six sigma project and Continuous Improvement and participate in root cause analysis.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of control system, chemical plant safety, environmental regulations, observation and troubleshooting skills.
  • Applicable Education, Experience, Licensing, and Capabilities:
  • B.S. degree in chemical, electrical, information engineering or mechanical engineering with certifications in various vendor training programs.
  • Proficient English communication skills (Verbal & Written)
  • 5 years of practical experience is required in the field of instrumentation, process control system design, and programming of PLCs and HMI software, especially, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley and GE products. 
  • Prior experience in a batch and continuous chemical or pharmaceutical environment is desirable.
  • Experience with quality discipline as practiced in the semiconductor industry preferred.
  • Six sigma YB or GB project leading experience and certification will be good.

Job Title:

Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering, APS

Job Description:

Job Description 

The APS Quality Engineering (QE) role is dynamic and cross-functional. QEs interact at multiple levels and with multiple contact points within the Customer, Entegris and Supplier organizations. This role is high impact, high output and high visibility that requires a calm-assertive demeanor and capability to manage multiple ever-changing priorities. Within this role, the PACE value competencies are regularly required for success. 

Job Overview:  

Entegris is seeking APS Quality Engineering (QE) for the Suwon, Korea location. Quality Engineering (QE) will work with customer bases, collaborating closely with internal and external customers. 

 

Main Product:  

  • This position will be dedicated to supporting a semiconductor industry leading IDM and our APS Division products; 1st primarily product, FOUP/Shipper product and 2nd primary product LMC(Liquid Micro-Contamination Control) and GMC(Gas Micro-Contamination Control),  

  • This is not limited to the items listed above, and additional product support may be required as needed. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Participate in varying levels of engagement with customers and company teams on Problem Solving, Change Management, Customer and Internal Audits, Project Development, Product Support and Development Programs as well as many other cross-functional tasks and projects that are aligned with Entegris and Customer goals.  

  • Be part of a global team that is designed to improve success of Entegris with our customers.  

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams at varying levels and varying degrees of complexity across a vast range of products, regions and companies. (Customers and suppliers). 

 

Qualifications: (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities, Education, Experience) 

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Chemical, Mechanical or Electric/Electronic Engineering; or related technical field preferred 

  • At least 5 years’ related experience and/or training in a semiconductor wafer/equipment manufacturing, raw materials supplier and equipment service-related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Control Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Engineer, Control Systems Engineering

Job Description:

The Role: 

Our JangAn, Korea facility is seeking a Senior Engineer, Control Systems Engineering to provide technical leadership for advanced automation systems supporting global manufacturing operations. This SME role drives the design, implementation, and optimization of OT hardware, instrumentation, control networks, and cybersecurity solutions while advancing process technology, automation standards, and strategic initiatives across global sites. 

 

As a semiconductor manufacturer, we maintain rigorous quality and process control standards, and this role is instrumental in advancing them through process optimization and innovative automation technologies. The position also provides opportunities to develop expertise in Rockwell Automation, Ignition, MES platforms (Critical Manufacturing), statistical process control, and automated process data collection and analytics. 

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Drive a Safety First culture by conducting behavioral and safety assessments and implementing equipment, automation, and process improvements to mitigate risk. 

  • Lead & Support projects to expand manufacturing capacity, transition products to high volume manufacturing, New Product Introductions and continuous improvement opportunities for existing processes and manufacturing sites. 

  • Engage cross‑functional stakeholders (Facilities/EHS, Procurement, R&D, Maintenance, Controls, Operations) to lead capital projects from justification through commissioning and qualification 

  • Drive implementation of connected manufacturing solutions including IIoT platforms, edge computing, industrial data infrastructure, historian systems, MES, AI/ML applications and vision systems as needed in alignment with Industry 4.0 vision and Divisional standards. 

  • Lead specifications, evaluation, and deployment of Automation hardware and software solutions, ensuring alignment with Divisional standards, cybersecurity requirements, and manufacturing objectives. 

  • Write, debug, and optimize PLC logic, and HMI/SCADA interfaces. Simulation testing of new automation programs and user acceptance testing in conjunction with cross-functional teams 

  • Collaborate with Controls, MES, ERP, and Business Systems teams to integrate production data, automate workflows, improve data visibility, and enable real-time decision-making. 

  • Develop business cases, ROI analyses, technology roadmaps, and implementation strategies that support site-specific and enterprise-wide digital manufacturing objectives as needed. 

  • Lead internal system commissioning, validation, and acceptance testing  

  • Provide leadership and expertise in global automation strategy, standards, and technology advancement. 

  • Collaborate with global teams to standardize architecture and engineering practices across sites.  

  • Drive Industry 4.0 and Smart manufacturing discussions and collaborative efforts for division and sites 

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions that improve reliability, scalability, performance, and business value.  

  • Develop and maintain a centralized repository of global IACS standards and technical assets, including PLC, HMI, and SCADA source code; equipment and instrument configuration files; I/O databases; instrument specifications; equipment standards; engineering procedures; automation best practices. 

  • Provide production support and serve as a subject matter expert and backup resource for site automation teams. 

  • Collaborate with site and global teams to resolve complex automation, controls, and integration issues.  

  • Provide on-call coverage during resource absences and support escalation of critical production events.  

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for automation-related downtime, quality issues, and system failures. 

  • Supply Plant floor support as needed for local sites complex issue resolution needs  

What We Seek: 

  • B.S. Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical) 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably batch or specialty chemical manufacturing. 

  • Experience managing capital and automation projects, including scope, schedule, budget, stakeholder communication and outage planning 

  • Expert-level proficiency in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA systems, Variable Frequency Drives and motion control.  

  • Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, DeviceNet, Ethernet/IP (preferred)) 

  • Ability to lead design efforts on multiple assignments of varying complexity including implementation of new products & processes, with ability to produce results when facing deadlines or commitments. 

  • Knowledge of or experience with AC/DC power distribution, control/pneumatic; cabinet designs and layouts, to include electrical schematics. 

  • Demonstrated familiarity with industrial instrumentation and the ability to select and specify devices for production processes, including pressure, vacuum, temperature, level, flow, and weighing systems. 

  • Working knowledge of safety systems and hazardous environments 

  • Demonstrated troubleshooting skills and root cause identification. 

  • Ability to travel (20% - Domestic & International) for site evaluations and commissioning activities 

Outstanding Candidates Will Have: 

  • Rockwell suite of applications (Studio5000/FTLinx/PlantPAX) 

  • IEC61131-3 Experience with LD, FBD, SFC and ST along with best use case implementation 

  • Ignition SCADA - (Python, REST APIs, MQTT & OPC-UA) design and Implementation 

  • Critical Manufacturing (MES) - Manufacturing Execution System integration and configuration 

  • Industrial Automation Networking - Experience configuring Stratix/Cisco switches. 

  • Knowledge of International Standards ISA88 (batch)/ ISA99 (cyber) / ISA95 (enterprise IACS) 

  • SQL Database experience (Stored Procedure generation), ODBC connections and transactional Data 

  • Experience with and exposure to virtualization technologies and associated implementation techniques 

  • Experience with and exposure to Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Application Whitelisting techniques 

  • Experience and exposure to Cyber Risk based security solutions (Tenable) and OT remediation action plans. 

What We Offer: 

At Entegris, we invest in providing opportunities for our employees and promote from within. The new hire in this role will have the potential to grow and create relationships across the organization and be recognized for demonstrated success and adherence to company PACE values.

jobs.title: Lead Scientist, CMP/pCMP
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Lead Scientist, CMP/pCMP

Job Description:

The Role: 

  • Entegris is seeking a Lead Scientist with deep chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and post-CMP cleaning (pCMP) experience to lead the development of advanced slurry and cleaning solutions for semiconductor applications.

  • In this role, you will apply broad technical expertise and in-depth knowledge of CMP and pCMP mechanisms to solve complex customer and product-development challenges. You will lead critical technical workstreams, define experimental strategies, and translate structure-performance relationships into differentiated products and process solutions.

  • The Lead Scientist will work across global R&D, Applications, Analytical, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, Marketing, and customer-facing teams. This position is an experienced technical leadership role and does not require direct people-management responsibility.

In this role you will: 

  • Technical Innovation & Product Development

    • Lead the formulation and process development of CMP slurries and pCMP cleaning chemistries for advanced semiconductor applications.
    • Define technical strategy, test plans, decision criteria, and development pathways for complex projects with significant technical ambiguity.
    • Establish structure-property-performance relationships involving abrasive particles, oxidizers, inhibitors, complexing agents, polymers, surfactants, dispersants, and cleaning additives.
    • Develop mechanistic understanding of material removal, selectivity, defectivity, corrosion, residue removal, particle contamination, surface condition, and formulation stability.
    • Design and direct statistically robust experiments, including DOE and multivariate analysis, and integrate wafer, coupon, analytical, and formulation data to guide development decisions.
    • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex slurry, cleaning, process, equipment, scale-up, and customer-performance issues.

  • Product Commercialization & Customer Success

    • Partner with Applications teams to design and execute CMP and pCMP evaluations on relevant films, substrates, test wafers, and patterned wafers.
    • Translate customer requirements and device/process trends into product specifications, technical milestones, and differentiated value propositions.
    • Lead technical reviews and communicate conclusions, risks, and recommendations to senior R&D leaders, cross-functional stakeholders, and customers.
    • Support raw-material selection, formulation robustness, scale-up, technology transfer, product qualification, and New Product Introduction.
    • Drive intellectual property creation through invention disclosures, patent support, technical documentation, and protection of proprietary know-how.

  • Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence

    • Provide technical mentorship to scientists, engineers, and technicians and help establish best practices for experimental rigor, data quality, and laboratory execution.
    • Build productive global networks and influence technical direction across teams without relying on direct authority.
    • Maintain exemplary EHS, chemical-handling, quality, and documentation practices and actively strengthen a safety-first culture.
    • Travel up to 30%, including customer sites and global technology or manufacturing locations, based on business needs.

Traits we believe make a strong candidate: 

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Surface Science, or a related field with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in CMP slurry development, pCMP cleaning development, CMP process development, or closely related semiconductor surface-processing technology.

  • Deep understanding of CMP and pCMP fundamentals, including surface chemistry, colloid and interface science, particle behavior, chemical-mechanical interactions, corrosion control, residue removal, and defect mechanisms.

  • Proven ability to independently solve complex, multi-variable technical problems and to determine appropriate methods, experiments, and decision criteria.

  • Strong record of designing and analyzing statistically rigorous experiments and converting complex datasets into clear technical conclusions and next steps.

  • Experience connecting formulation composition and process conditions to removal rate, selectivity, defects, surface quality, cleaning efficiency, and product robustness.

  • Experience with semiconductor materials such as metals, dielectrics, barrier or liner films, and advanced interconnect materials is preferred.

  • Experience supporting customer engagements, product qualification, scale-up, technology transfer, or commercialization is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership, influence, mentoring capability, and effective collaboration across global and cross-functional organizations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technically complex information in English to global teams and customers.

  • Strong commitment to laboratory safety, data integrity, intellectual property protection, and disciplined technical documentation.

Your success will be measured by: 

  • Technical leadership: Establishes credible technical direction and resolves high-impact CMP and pCMP challenges through sound scientific judgment.

  • Innovation and differentiation: Creates protectable formulations, mechanisms, methods, or product concepts that deliver meaningful customer value.

  • Project impact: Delivers critical technical milestones, manages uncertainty and risk, and enables timely project decisions.

  • Customer relevance: Connects customer process requirements to practical, robust, and differentiated material solutions.

  • Collaboration and influence: Builds effective global partnerships and aligns cross-functional teams around evidence-based recommendations.

  • Talent development: Raises team capability through mentoring, technical reviews, knowledge sharing, and rigorous experimental standards.

  • Safety and quality: Demonstrates visible leadership in EHS, data integrity, documentation, and product-development discipline.

jobs.title: Director, Margin Expansion and Profitability
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Director, Margin Expansion and Profitability

Job Description:

Job Description

The Role

 Pricing is a key strategic capability at Entegris. The new Director, Margin Expansion and Profitability will establish and lead enterprise pricing strategy, governance, analytics, and execution to accelerate profitable growth across products, customers, markets, and regions. This leader will partner with senior executives and cross-functional leaders in Sales, Finance, Product Management, Marketing, Operations, and Information Technology to translate market, customer, competitive, and cost insights into actionable pricing decisions. If hired into this role, you will build scalable processes, tools, and organizational capabilities; lead complex transformation initiatives; and provide clear recommendations on price, volume, mix, portfolio, and margin tradeoffs.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative commercially oriented, data-driven people leader who can operate effectively in a global, matrixed environment and influence decisions at the executive level. 

What You'll Do:

  • Define and execute a multi-year pricing strategy aligned with enterprise growth, market positioning, customer value, and profitability objectives. 

  • Serve as the senior pricing advisor to executive and business leaders, providing fact-based recommendations on price, volume, mix, portfolio, contracts, and margin tradeoffs. 

  • Establish division pricing governance, decision rights, approval thresholds, policies, controls, and performance standards that improve consistency, speed, and accountability. 

  • Lead value-based pricing, segmentation, lifecycle pricing, new-product pricing, annual price planning, discount management, and margin recovery initiatives across the portfolio. 

  • Direct advanced pricing analytics, scenario modeling, elasticity assessment, competitive intelligence, and performance reporting to identify revenue and margin opportunities. 

  • Partner with Business and Sales leaders on strategic customer negotiations, deal structures, exception decisions, and commercial programs while balancing customer value and long-term profitability. 

  • Own the pricing transformation roadmap, including process redesign, data quality, system enablement, automation, and integration with SAP and related commercial platforms. 

  • Work with the business teams on product life cycle management, maximizing the value of and optimizing our product portfolio from concept through retirement. 

  • Influence across functions, business units, and regions to drive adoption of pricing strategies, tools, and behaviors in a complex global matrix. 

  • Develop executive-level dashboards and operating reviews that measure price realization, margin expansion, leakage, exception activity, adoption, and return on pricing initiatives. 

  

What We Seek:

  • Enterprise mindset with the strategic judgment to connect pricing decisions to customer value, market dynamics, portfolio strategy, and financial outcomes. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, align senior stakeholders, and drive adoption across global, cross-functional, and matrixed teams. 

  • Exceptional analytical and financial acumen, including the ability to translate complex data into concise insights, decisions, and measurable business actions. 

  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, simplify ambiguity, and present compelling recommendations to senior leadership. 

  • Strong people leadership, talent development, change leadership, and program management capabilities. 

Outstanding Candidates Will Have: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred. 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in pricing, commercial strategy, finance, product management, revenue management, sales operations, or a related discipline, including significant leadership responsibility. 

  • Proven success designing and implementing pricing strategy, governance, analytics, and transformation initiatives in a complex business-to-business environment; experience in global manufacturing, technology, or semiconductor-related industries preferred. 

  • Demonstrated record of delivering measurable revenue and margin improvement through value-based pricing, segmentation, portfolio optimization, discount management, and commercial execution. 

  • Experience leading and developing teams, managing enterprise-scale programs, and influencing executive stakeholders without direct authority. 

  • Advanced financial modeling, data interpretation, and business case development skills; proficiency with Excel, business intelligence tools, pricing platforms, and enterprise systems such as SAP strongly preferred. 

  • Ability to operate across time zones and travel domestically or internationally as business needs require. 

WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS?
Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Analytical R&D
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Scientist, Analytical R&D

Job Description:

The Role 

 

Entegris is seeking a Senior Analytical Scientist to join our Analytical R&D team at our Ansan Korea Technology Center (KTC) facility. 

In this role, you will lead the development, validation, and continuous improvement of analytical methods used to characterize complex materials, mixtures, and formulations. You will apply advanced analytical chemistry, metrology, and statistical techniques to support new product development, improve existing products, resolve challenging technical problems, and respond to internal and external customer needs. You will work closely with global R&D, engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, marketing, and external laboratory partners.  

 

What You’ll Do 

  •  Support the development, optimization, validation, and transfer of analytical methods for complex analyses. 

  • Design and execute analytical experiments, interpret data, draw technically sound conclusions, and communicate results through reports, presentations, and discussions with technical teams and customers. 

  • Establish and document method performance characteristics, including detection limits, accuracy, precision, stability, robustness, and measurement-system capability. 

  • Collaborate with product-development teams to define analytical requirements for new materials, formulations, and products. 

  • Evaluate, qualify, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical instrumentation such as ICP-MS, ICP-OES, ion chromatography, HPLC, and FTIR. 

  • Support analytical method change-impact assessments and contribute to cross-functional safety, readiness, and change-control reviews. 

  • Prepare and maintain SOPs, work instructions, technical reports, method validation documentation, measurement-system analyses, and verification or qualification records. 

  • Provide technical guidance and training to laboratory colleagues on analytical instrumentation, methods, data interpretation, documentation, and safe laboratory practices. 

  • Support global analytical-development programs and collaborate effectively with R&D teams, manufacturing engineers, quality partners, and external laboratories. 

  •  Promote a strong safety culture and maintain audit-ready laboratory practices while handling chemicals and performing work in laboratory and cleanroom environments.   

 

What We Seek 

  •  Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a closely related scientific discipline.      

  • At least three years of relevant experience in an analytical, R&D, product-development, or comparable laboratory environment. 

  • Demonstrated experience developing, validating, or improving analytical methods for complex materials, mixtures, formulations, or high-purity products. 

  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant analytical techniques, such as ICP-MS, ICP-OES, ion chromatography, HPLC, or FTIR. 

  • Ability to design experiments, analyze technical data, evaluate method performance, and translate findings into clear conclusions and recommendations. 

  • Understanding of measurement-system analysis, method capability, statistical analysis, root-cause investigation, and corrective-action principles. 

  • Experience preparing controlled technical documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, validation protocols, qualification records, and reports. 

  • Ability to work safely with hazardous materials and follow applicable laboratory, cleanroom, chemical-handling, and personal-protective-equipment requirements. 

  • Strong project-management, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the flexibility to manage multiple assignments and respond to changing business needs. 

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including professional proficiency in English. 

  • Ability to collaborate across functions, cultures, languages, and geographic locations. 

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 10% to 20%, including international travel.        

 

Outstanding Candidates Will Have 

  •  Hands-on expertise with trace-metals analysis, high-purity chemical analysis, or analytical characterization of complex formulations.  

  • Experience qualifying new analytical instrumentation or transferring analytical methods between laboratories or global sites. 

  • Knowledge of semiconductor materials, specialty chemicals, high-purity manufacturing, or contamination-control requirements. 

  • Experience supporting new-product introduction and working directly with manufacturing, quality, commercial teams, external laboratories, or customers. 

  • Professional proficiency in Korean and English.   

 

Why Work at Entegris 

 

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. 

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. 

 

What We Offer 

 

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. 

  • Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match 

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs 

  • Flexible work schedule and 11 paid holidays a year 

  • Paid time off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge 

  • Education assistance to support your learning journey 

  • Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence 

 

Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future. 

 

At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

jobs.title: Manager, Materials Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Manager, Materials Quality Engineering

Job Description:

Manager, Materials Quality Engineering 

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Manager of Materials Quality Engineering (MQE), based in the Suwon office, to lead a regional team of individuals supporting critical raw materials and supplier quality activities across chemistry (organic and inorganic) and gas commodities. This role will provide people leadership, technical direction, and strategic oversight for team members in Korea, Taiwan, and China, strengthening a prevention-focused quality culture while ensuring strong execution across the four MQE pillars: Supplier Management, Raw Material Management, Management of Change, and New Product Development. 

The MQE Manager will lead a team and partner closely with Korea operations, regional MQE teams, Procurement, Operations, R&D, Customer Quality, and suppliers to drive robust material performance, disciplined change control, proactive risk mitigation, and aligned support for regional manufacturing and global MQE priorities. 

Key Responsibilities 

People Leadership & Talent Development 

  • Lead, coach, and develop a regional team of Materials Quality Engineers supporting chemistry and gas commodities across Korea, Taiwan, and China. 

  • Manage and support employees located both in-person and remote, ensuring inclusive communication, balanced workload distribution, and effective collaboration with local plants and global partners. 

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning. 

  • Build technical capability through structured training, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across chemistry, gas, supplier quality, and raw material management disciplines. 

  • Promote collaboration, clear communication, and trust. 

MQE Pillar Leadership 

  • Engage and influence Korea operations, Taiwan and China team members, global MQE partners, business stakeholders, Procurement, R&D, Customer Quality, and suppliers to build alignment, clarify decision rights, and drive timely execution across all pillars. 

  • Communicate clearly and respectfully, translating complex technical and program information into concise, actionable insights tailored to engineers, leadership, suppliers, and customers. 

  • Provide technical guidance on investigations and prevention across chemistry and gas commodities, including failure analysis, root cause, SPC, FMEA, control plans, and risk mitigation. 

  • Represent MQE as a steady, credible, and solutions‑oriented leader during audits, escalations, supplier reviews, and cross‑functional forums, ensuring a consistent voice and disciplined follow-through. 

  • Ensure consistent MQE support for Korea-based operations and regional supplier quality needs across Korea, Taiwan, and China, balancing local responsiveness with global standards and commodity alignment. 

Execution & Governance 

  • Establish the operating rhythm to manage performance, risk, and improvement across the four MQE pillars for Korea operations and regional chemistry and gas supplier quality support. 

  • Ensure timely reporting of status, risks, and deliverables, escalating issues early and enabling fact-based decisions. 

  • Deploy best‑practice program management frameworks to drive cross-functional alignment, accountability, and on-time execution. 

External Engagement 

  • Serve as an escalation point for supplier investigations, excursions, audits, and customer-facing quality issues tied to Korea-, Taiwan-, and China-supported chemistry and gas raw materials, ensuring disciplined containment, communication, and closure. 

  • Ensure high-quality external communication packages (technical reports, OCAPs, 8Ds, and presentations) that align to customer expectations and internal standards. 

  • Lead supplier quality engagements for chemistry and gas commodities, including corrective and preventive actions, audit readiness, process capability reviews, and sustained closure of systemic issues. 

Quality Systems & Operational Excellence 

  • Ensure compliance with global quality policies, raw material control plans, supplier quality expectations, and management of change requirements across Korea-, Taiwan-, and China-supported chemistry and gas materials. 

  • Maintain zero‑overdue CAR, OFIs, OCAPs, or CRs. 

  • Monitor and improve key performance indicators (e.g., OOC%, QN/NCMR cycle time, SPC maturity, EQOS, change cycle time, and investigation timeliness) and drive corrective action when performance drifts. 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred. 

  • 10+ years industry experience; 3+ years people leadership required. 

  • Fluency in Korean and English required; additional fluency in Mandarin or another regional language is a plus. 

  • Experience managing employees across multiple locations and collaborating across global, cross-functional teams preferred. 

  • Strong understanding of SPC, FMEA, supplier quality systems, materials characterization, chemistry, gas manufacturing, specialty gases, and raw material process controls. Six Sigma Green Belt desired. 

  • Proficiency with Minitab, JMP, SAS, SAP, Power BI, Microsoft Office. 

Travel: Up to 20%, including travel between Korea operations, regional team locations in Taiwan and China, suppliers, and regional/global meetings as needed.

jobs.title: Lead Account Manager, Enablement Partner
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Lead Account Manager, Enablement Partner

Job Description:

The Role: Principal Account Manager, Enablement Partner 

This position is primarily dedicated to supporting Samsung Electronics, one of Entegris' most strategic global semiconductor customers, by leading customer enablement activities and driving commercial execution excellence. 

The person will be responsible for managing and growing existing business by collaborating closely with the Business Units, Customer Service, Technical Support, Quality, Production, and Sales Support teams. This role involves forecasting revenue, ensuring on-time delivery, and, when necessary, expediting product deliveries to enhance customer satisfaction. Additionally, the candidate will work closely with the Account Management team to identify, develop, and lead selected new business opportunities based on account priorities, product scope, and candidate capability. This role will serve as a dedicated Customer Enablement partner focused on sustaining existing business, improving customer experience, supporting market share expansion from the installed base, selectively leading new business development opportunities, and strengthening commercial execution through forecast discipline, allocation visibility, PCN horizon planning, AR issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination. 

 

Primary Responsibilities and Duties: 

  • Lead and manage existing customer business across Entegris’ broad portfolio of products and solutions, supporting sustained growth, customer satisfaction, and stronger commercial execution. 

  • Own sustained existing business management, including revenue protection, recurring demand visibility, customer satisfaction, and share-of-wallet expansion within current programs. 

  • Orchestrate Entegris’ assets, resources, and systems to deliver a state-of-the-art customer experience when customers use Entegris solutions and products. 

  • Manage product forecasting, allocation, on-time delivery, and expedite requests. 

  • Develop and maintain a rolling 18-month forecast view in partnership with customers, Account Management, Business Units, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to improve planning accuracy and reduce supply risk. 

  • Market share gains from existing business. 

  • Contribute to revenue growth through strategic collaboration with the Account Management team on new business development. 

  • Lead enablement service standards for key customers by proactively managing allocation constraints, order blocks, expedite requests, DOI oversight, PCN readiness, and AR-related issue resolution. 

  • Drive revenue growth and achieve or exceed sales targets for existing business. 

  • Lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams, including Product Marketing, Quality, Application Engineering, and Customer Support, to sustain ongoing business operations. 

  • Maintain a strong understanding of market share and use this insight to prioritize growth opportunities. 

  • Use technical expertise to accurately identify customer issues and proactively lead solution development in collaboration with internal teams. 

  • Create case studies and repeatable best practices from customer enablement activities to support scalable execution across top customers and small-to-midsize accounts. 

  • Provide the appropriate level of technical application support to ensure smooth PCN implementation. 

  • Maximize margins and protect ASP (average selling price) by minimizing discounts and maximizing price increases. 

  • Effectively present the benefits and capabilities of Entegris technology. 

  • Conduct regular analyses of revenue and product quality issues to understand customer needs and collaborate with the account team to identify new opportunities. 

  • Provide quotations, solicit purchase orders, and finalize sales. 

  • Effectively manage customer expectations regarding inventory support while mitigating risk and protecting Entegris assets. 

 

Qualifications (Education, Training, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Physical Requirements): 

  • Proven success in achieving revenue targets and Business Unit goals, as well as executing marketing strategies end to end. 

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working in a matrixed environment and managing multiple priorities under dynamic timelines. 

  • A self-driven technical sales professional who leads growth and ensures customer satisfaction. 

  • Bilingual fluency in English and Korean. 

  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and plans. 

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry and 10+ years of work experience with IDMs, chemical suppliers, or equipment suppliers. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead negotiations and work through ambiguity. 

  • Balanced technical and business acumen. 

 

Your success will be measured by: 

People and Teamwork  

  • Strong individual contributor  

  • Self-motivated, curious, and creative problem solver. 

Accountability, Integrity, Trust  

  • Strong communication and presentation skills. 

  • Reliable, respectful, and trusted colleague. 

Creativity and Innovation  

  • Creatively collaborate across functions in a matrixed organization. 

Dedication to Excellence  

  • Delivery regional sales objectives. 

  • Provide input on how to improve products, services, and business practices. 

  • Improvement in forecast accuracy, on-time shipment visibility, allocation management, PCN readiness, and customer experience metrics for existing business.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Specialist, Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator

Job Description:

Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator (L2) 

 

The Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator enables faster innovation and on-time, high-quality NPI delivery by managing the compliant movement of materials, components, and customer samples across a global network of sites and regions. This role plays a critical part in “shifting left” key readiness and compliance activities, such as SDS country and language requirements and material and site readiness, ensuring that issues are identified and resolved early rather than at the point of shipment. By proactively identifying risks and coordinating cross-functional execution, this role enables R&D teams to focus on innovation while ensuring products are delivered to customers with speed, quality, and reliability. 

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Drive NPI Sampling Execution (Speed & Proactivity) and Continuous Improvement 

  • Coordinate end-to-end R&D shipments, receivals, and sample requests, proactively identifying and resolving risks early to ensure on-time material staging, component availability, and customer sample delivery while minimizing delays. 

  • Identify bottlenecks and support improvements to reduce turnaround time, improve data quality, and standardize processes. 

  • Identify root causes of delays or execution issues (e.g., missing data, process gaps, system limitations) and take ownership to drive resolution, leveraging cross-functional partners to remove roadblocks and prevent recurrence. 

Execute Customer Sample Shipments (Quality & Reliability) 

  • Ensure shipments are accurate, compliant, and right-first time, including proper documentation, packaging, and traceability. 

  • Facilitate compliance workflows as needed to ensure the complete and correct documentation is aligned to origin and destination requirements. 

Operate Across a Global, Cross-functional Environment 

  • Manage shipments across multiple regions and time zones, addressing regional requirements and coordinating local and non-local sampling scenarios. 

  • Serve as the central point of coordination across R&D, TPM, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Trade Compliance, EHS, and Quality, ensuring clear ownership and efficient handoffs. 

Manage Global RM Movement 

  • Coordinate internal transfers of materials and components across global sites, ensuring material, site readiness, and documentation requirements are met to enable seamless execution. 

  • Work closely with R&D, TPM, MQE and commodity managers to proactively obtain or stage materials and components at global sites, and evaluate RM options based on supplier, quality, availability, and location. 

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in engineering, chemistry, or a related field. 

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously. 

  • High attention to detail, particularly in documentation and compliance-driven processes. 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with global teams across regions and time zones. 

  • Experience supporting R&D, customer sampling, or NPI-related workflows. 

  • Demonstrated interest in process improvement and proactive problem-solving. 

  • Familiarity with ERP or logistics systems (e.g., SAP). 

  • Exposure to trade compliance concepts (e.g., ECCN, HTS, export/import documentation, SDS). 

 

Success Measures (What Good Looks Like):

  • Sampling and internal material and component movements are executed quickly, with reduced turnaround time and minimal delays. 

  • Risks and gaps are identified early and addressed before impacting customer deliveries—no “last-minute” issues. 

  • Shipments are executed with complete and accurate documentation, reducing rework and compliance risk. 

  • Cross-region shipments and coordination are handled smoothly with minimal friction or rework. 

  • Teams are aligned, roles are clear, and handoffs between functions are efficient. 

  • R&D teams spend less time on coordination and issue resolution, allowing increased focus on developing and delivering innovative solutions.

jobs.title: Plant Purchasing Operations Partner
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Plant Purchasing Operations Partner

Job Description:

The Role 

Serves as the site-level purchasing operations lead, directly supporting plant execution and ensuring uninterrupted material flow. Acts as the plant's voice within the Purchasing Center, representing site priorities and operational requirements while ensuring alignment with enterprise procurement processes, standard work, and governance. Leads resolution of complex supply and execution challenges impacting production schedules, customer commitments, inventory health, and operational performance.

Partners closely with Planning, Operations, Quality, Logistics, and Procurement Operations teams to mitigate risk, coordinate escalations, and drive timely resolution of supply constraints, shortages, and fulfillment issues. Provides advanced procurement operations leadership through influence rather than direct authority, ensuring consistent execution practices, visibility to supplier performance risks, and alignment between site priorities and regional purchasing center activities. Supports continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service, reliability, and execution effectiveness across the supply chain.  

 

What You'll Do 

  • Lead resolution of complex supply and procurement execution challenges, including constrained supply, material shortages, inventory risk, and production-impacting disruptions. 

  • Coordinate and drive escalation management between plants, suppliers, Planning, Quality, and Purchasing Center teams to ensure rapid issue resolution. 

  • Serve as the primary site liaison for Procurement Operations, ensuring plant priorities and requirements are appropriately represented in execution decisions. 

  • Identify and communicate emerging supplier performance, supply continuity, and fulfillment risks that may impact operational performance. 

  • Partner with Planning and Operations teams to ensure procurement execution supports production schedules, inventory strategies, and customer demand requirements. 

  • Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective action activities for recurring supply disruptions and execution gaps. 

  • Ensure purchasing execution risks and performance gaps are appropriately elevated through operational governance forums, including S&OE and S&OP processes. 

  • Promote standard work, escalation disciplines, and purchasing governance practices across supported sites. 

  • Analyze purchasing execution performance and leverage key metrics to identify improvement opportunities related to on-time delivery, inventory health, fulfillment accuracy, and issue resolution effectiveness. 

  • Support implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives, and digital tools that improve visibility, standardization, and execution performance. 

  • Provide guidance and subject matter expertise to procurement, planning, and operational stakeholders on purchasing processes, escalation management, and risk mitigation strategies.  

 

What We Seek 

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 6 years with a master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Purchasing, Procurement Operations, Operations, or a related field. 

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex procurement execution, supply continuity, supplier performance, and exception management challenges. 

  • Advanced knowledge of procurement operations, purchasing processes, supply planning concepts, and ERP/MRP systems (SAP preferred). 

  • Experience leading cross-functional issue resolution and influencing stakeholders across Planning, Operations, Quality, Logistics, Finance, and Procurement teams. 

  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks, analyze data, and develop practical solutions that improve operational performance and supply reliability. 

  • Experience developing or supporting governance processes, KPI management, escalation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority. 

  • Experience leveraging metrics, dashboards, and operational performance indicators to support decision-making and improve execution outcomes. 

 

Why Work at Entegris  

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. At Entegris, our employees bring diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives that help generate new ideas and better outcomes. What We Offer  

Our total rewards package extends beyond a paycheck. Whether you are focused on career growth, health, or financial well-being, we offer generous benefits designed to help you reach your goals. 

  • Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match  

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs

  • Paid time off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering

Job Description:

THE ROLE: 

We are seeking a senior manufacturing engineer to drive the design, development, and optimization of advanced automation systems and further develop key manufacturing process technology for fluid management production lines in Munmak, Korea, supporting the Advanced Purity Solutions Division. 

This role requires a strong technical background and hands-on experience to ensure smooth production operations, optimize manufacturing systems, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

You will partner closely with cross-functional to standardize automation platforms, accelerate deployment of strategic initiatives, and strengthen overall manufacturing performance. 

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Develop, implement and optimize manufacturing process to ensure maximum efficiency and productivity. 

  • Lead continuous improvement project focused on boosting productivity and reducing scrap to achieve plant KPIs. 

  • Provide data driven insights for manufacturing decisions and risk based solutions to minimize production issues and meet on time shipment (OTS). 

  • Create and maintain manufacturing methods for all activities, ensuring accuracy and precision in line with engineering specifications. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for process improvement and implement solutions to enhance manufacturing capabilities. 

  • Conduct regular assessments of production equipment and recommend necessary upgrades or modifications to improve overall performance or increase capacity.

  • Analyze existing capacity and future demand. Propose additional equipment if necessary. 

  • Provide technical support, training and guidance to production teams to resolve any problem and ensure smooth workflow. 

  • Stay updated with latest advancements in our technology and industry and best practices to continually improve manufacturing processes. 

  • Work closely with design engineering to provide input during the product development stage, ensuring manufacturability and cost-effectiveness.

What We Seek:

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams to achieve common goals.

Outstanding candidates will have:

Job Title:

Lead, Lab Quality Engineering

Job Description:

Why work at Entegris? 
 
Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. 
 
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences, and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. Entegris is a values-driven culture, and our employees rally around our core PACE values:  
 
People  
Accountability 

Creativity  
Excellence 

 

POSITION SUMMARY 

Entegris is seeking a Global Lab Quality Engineer to oversee quality aspects of Materials Solutions QC labs with a focus on slurries and slurry related products.  This role is primarily responsible for ensuring MS QC labs are following Entegris Quality and good laboratory practices.  This position can be either US (Aurora) or Asia Pacific (Korea, Taiwan) based.  

In this role you will: 

The Lab Quality Engineer’s role is to implement methods across Materials Solution QC labs.  The role is a cross functional role that requires interactions with all levels of the organization including customers and suppliers.  This role requires an individual that has a strong quality mindset, is internally motivated, can work independently and can navigate a constantly changing and sometime ambiguous landscape.    

Primary Responsibilities: 

  • Work with MS QC labs to ensure methods (POR and new) adhere to our best-known methods. 

  • Review new method plans and results to ensure all parameters are passing. 

  • When needed transfer methods from existing factories to new ones and train chemists as needed with the goal of reducing changes made from site to site. 

  • Support planning process for QC labs in new factories. 

  • Support BU and CQEs with data packages needed for new products, PCNs, AMLC etc.  

  • Be voice of the lab with regard to data that is shared with customers. 

  • Assist labs in implementing controls that will improve and reduce trouble shooting efforts. 

  • Develop training for labs on quality assurance practices regarding data analysis and interpretation. 

  • Facilitate end-user training and provide on-going support. 

  • Audit and Evaluate Lab methods for consistency and best-known methodology. 

  • Improve laboratory consistency and quality ISO compliance by creating and revising laboratory policies and procedures. 

  • Ensure Quality CAPA’s are shared and implemented across the division. 

  • Support audits (internal and external) as needed.
