jobs.title: Senior Engineer Sustaining Process Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Engineer Sustaining Process Engineering

Job Description:

Job Opportunity: Sr. Engineer, Sustaining Process Engineering 

Location: Ansan, South Korea. 
Division: Materials Solutions (MS) 
Reports To: Director of Fab Technology and Engineering 

 

Core Purpose of the Role 

The Sustaining Process Engineer will be a key member of the Hardware Sustaining team, responsible for maintaining stable performance of Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tools and associated process modules through upkeep and improvement of Entegris precursor delivery cabinet product line. This role focuses on cabinet reliability, process stability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to enable highvolume production at our customers’ sites.  

 

The engineer will collaborate closely with equipment engineers, technicians, and manufacturing teams to ensure our precursor delivery cabinet product line enables ALD hardware and process modules to operate at top performance with minimal downtime. 

 

Entegris is seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric Global Sustaining Process Engineer to support our deployed Precursor Delivery Systems Product Line globally. This role is essential to ensuring safe, high-quality, and timely installations while driving strategic capacity-building initiatives to support our customers and expand our market presence. 

 

Primary accountability is post-release sustaining of the installed base (process stability, reliability improvement, and standardization). This role does not own new process development, initial tool deployment/commissioning, or day-to-day field execution. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Tool & Hardware Sustaining 

  • Serve as sustaining technical owner for ALD hardware modules and chambers (thermal and plasmaenhanced). 

  • Work with our OEM/IDM partners to gain understanding of tool health, performance, stability, and hardware degradation trends as they relate to our chemistry supply cabinets and use the gain knowledge to provide feedback for improvements. 

  • Identify and resolve chronic tool issues, hardware failures, and longterm reliability gaps. 

  • Define and optimize preventive maintenance (PM) procedures on our PDCs to improve uptime and chamber stability. 

  • Partner with Equipment Engineering to improve MTBF/MTTR and reduce unscheduled downtime. 

​

2. Process Stability & Control 

  • Provide tool understanding to improve process performance across the installed base. 

  • Monitor SPC charts, alarms, excursion trends, and chambertochamber matching limitations. 

  • Assess out-of-control or out-of-spec conditions by performing structured analysis and defining standardized recovery/prevention plans in collaboration with operations teams. 

  • Support recipe stabilization and standardized tuning guidance after hardware events (e.g., chamber clean, parts replacement, kit change). 

3. Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis 

  • Lead root cause investigations for process drift, particle issues, metrology shifts, and equipment faults. 

  • Utilize structured problemsolving methods (5Why, Fishbone, DMAIC, 8D). 

  • Coordinate crossfunctional response plans and corrective actions after tool or process excursions. 

  • Coordinate with OEMs and internal stakeholders to review recurring issues, reliability trends, and corrective actions through established change-control and sustaining review processes. 

4. Continuous Improvement 

  • Drive initiatives to improve tool availability, throughput, and cost-of-ownership. 

  • Optimize chamber parts life, process chamber kits, and ALD module performance. 

  • Evaluate hardware changes, new components, or retrofit kits for performance improvement. 

  • Support hardware qualifications, engineering change orders (ECO), and configuration control. 

5. Documentation & Communication 

  • Document chamber health parameters, troubleshooting procedures, and best-known methods (BKMs). 

  • Provide clear handoff updates to manufacturing, equipment teams, and shift engineering. 

  • Present findings, trends, and improvement opportunities to sustaining leadership. 

 

Qualifications 

Required 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on experience with ALD or thinfilm deposition systems in a manufacturing environment. 

  • Strong understanding of vacuum systems, gas panels, valves, plasma systems, and hardware interactions. 

  • Proficiency with SPC, data analysis, and troubleshooting of semiconductor process tools. 

  • Ability to manage priorities in a fastpaced production setting. 

  • Ability to travel internationally up to 50%. 

  • English proficiency required. 

Preferred 

  • Experience in hardware sustaining, equipment reliability, or tool ownership roles. 

  • Familiarity with ALD platforms from ASM, Lam Research, TEL, Applied Materials, or similar. 

  • Understanding of chamber matching, kit management, and processequipment interaction. 

  • Experience with JMP, Python, or other data analytics tools. 

  • Knowledge of contamination control and cleanroom operation. 

Key Competencies 

  • Strong mechanical aptitude with process understanding 

  • Excellent troubleshooting and rootcause analysis skills 

  • Clear communication and crossfunctional collaboration 

  • Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability and uptime 

  • Ability to drive hardware and process improvements independently 

 

Success Metrics 

Success in this role is measured not only by project outcomes but also by how those outcomes are achieved. Key competencies include: 

  • Safety First: Promote and maintain a safe work environment. 

  • Team Building and Collaboration: Share knowledge and support team success. 

  • Accountability: Take ownership of tasks and deliver results. 

  • Customer Centricity: Prioritize customer needs and satisfaction. 

  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 

  • Communication: Effectively engage across all levels of the organization and with customers. 

 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a global leader in advanced materials and delivery systems. 

  • Work on high-impact projects with cross-functional and international teams. 

  • Drive innovation and capacity growth in a critical industry sector. 

  • Enjoy competitive compensation, professional development, and global exposure.

Join our teams mobilized to meet the challenge of accelerating electrification!

At the heart of electric mobility, Valeo Power brings together expertise in thermal management systems and propulsion systems. This division develops innovations that contribute to the mobility of tomorrow by reducing pollutant emissions and maximizing vehicle autonomy.

The site of Daegu based in Korea belongs to POWER Division. The site has 6,000 employees. We are looking for a VIE R&D Engineer - AI & Automotive Engineering Tools for 24 months within the team.

  • You will develop and deploy AI-based tools to optimize design, simulation, and testing in the areas of powertrains, electric motors, battery systems, and thermal management.

  • You will also lead technical implementation, market analysis, and budget forecasting activities across all of our major development sites in South Korea, China, and Mexico.

 Let’s talk about you…

Please, don't forget to apply in English to facilitate the process with our managers. 

Why Valeo?

jobs.description:
Job Description

GM Korea GPSC(Global Purchasing & Supply Chain)는 구매·공급망·물류 전반을 유기적으로 연결해 GM 글로벌 생산 네트워크의 안정적인 운영과 경쟁력 강화를 이끄는 핵심 조직입니다. 글로벌 협력사와의 전략적 파트너십을 바탕으로 부품과 서비스의 품질·기술·원가 경쟁력을 높이고, 수요·공급 계획, 생산·물류 운영, 공급 리스크 관리 및 데이터·AI 기반 디지털 혁신을 통해 더 스마트하고 회복탄력적인 공급망을 구축하고 있습니다. 또한 한국의 우수한 협력사와 GM 글로벌 사업을 연결하며 미래 모빌리티 산업의 지속가능한 성장을 만들어가고 있습니다. 글로벌 자동차 산업의 변화를 함께 이끌고 구매·공급망 분야의 전문가로 성장할 신입사원을 모집하오니 많은 지원 바랍니다.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**지원서 작성 안내 : 지원서 작성 시 희망 지원 직무를 반드시 기재해 주세요.


1. AI Tool Lead

The Role –

AI Tool Lead는 한국지엠 전반의 인공지능(AI), 자동화, 데이터 분석 및 디지털 전환 기회를 발굴하고, 이를 실질적인 사업 성과와 지속 가능한 업무 방식으로 전환하는 역할을 담당합니다.

특히 공급업체 견적서와 원가 데이터를 기반으로 협상 및 비용 절감 기회를 도출하고, 구매 담당자의 의사결정을 지원하는 AI 기반 구매 분석 시스템을 개발·운영합니다. 또한 과제의 성과와 실행 현황을 체계적으로 관리하며, 기대 성과를 달성하지 못했거나 중단된 과제는 원인을 진단하여 개선·재추진·대체 방안을 수립합니다.

내부 조직 및 외부 기술 파트너와 협업하여 AI 솔루션을 현업에 정착시키고, 데이터 보호·정보 보안·모델 성능·사람의 검토와 통제를 포함한 책임 있는 AI 활용 기준을 수립합니다. 검증된 성공 사례는 여러 조직으로 확산하여 전사적인 업무 혁신을 추진합니다.


What You’ll Do -

  • 전사 AI, 자동화, 데이터 분석 및 디지털 전환 과제를 발굴하고, 사업 가치와 실행 가능성을 기준으로 우선순위를 관리합니다.
  • 업무 현장의 문제를 구체적인 AI 적용 과제로 전환하고, 기대 가치, 데이터 준비 수준, 구현 난이도, 위험 요소 및 필요 자원을 평가합니다.
  • 공급업체 견적서와 원가 데이터를 분석하여 협상 및 비용 절감 기회를 발굴하고, 구매 의사결정을 지원하는 AI 기반 구매 분석 시스템을 개발·운영합니다.
  • 구매 분석 결과와 비용 절감 성과를 추적하고, 데이터에 기반한 지속적인 개선을 추진합니다.
  • 진행이 중단되었거나 기대한 성과를 달성하지 못한 과제의 근본 원인을 진단하고, 정상화·재추진·대체 계획을 수립합니다.
  • 업무 담당 부서, 기술·데이터 조직 및 외부 기술 파트너와 업무 요구사항, 데이터, 사용자 요구사항 및 기술 설계를 조율합니다.
  • 데이터 보호, 정보 보안, 모델 성능, 사람의 검토 및 통제를 포함한 안전하고 책임감 있는 AI 개발·활용 기준을 수립합니다.
  • 교육, 변화 관리 및 운영 체계를 마련하여 AI 시범 과제를 지속 가능한 업무 활용으로 전환합니다.
  • AI 활용 현황과 사업 성과를 측정하고, 진행 상황, 주요 의사결정, 성과 및 교훈을 경영진에 보고합니다.
  • 검증된 모범 사례를 공유하고 성공적인 솔루션을 여러 조직으로 확대합니다.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) -

  • AI, 자동화, 데이터 분석 또는 디지털 전환 과제를 발굴하고 실제 업무에 적용한 경험이 있습니다.
  • AI 및 자동화 기술의 활용 가능성, 사업 가치, 데이터 요구사항 및 솔루션 구현 가능성을 이해합니다.
  • 성과가 미흡한 기술 과제의 원인을 분석하고, 실현 가능한 개선 및 정상 운영 전환 계획을 수립할 수 있습니다.
  • 프로젝트 관리, 이해관계자 조율, 효과적인 커뮤니케이션 및 변화 주도 역량을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 업무 담당 부서, 기술·데이터 조직 및 외부 기술 파트너와 협업할 수 있습니다.
  • 글로벌 및 다양한 기능 조직과 협업할 수 있는 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 주인의식, 체계적인 문제 해결 능력 및 새로운 기술을 배우고 적용하려는 자세를 갖추고 있습니다.
  • 기술을 안전하고 책임감 있게 활용하려는 높은 윤리의식을 갖추고 있습니다.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) -

  • 공급업체 견적서, 원가 및 구매 데이터를 분석하고 비용 절감 기회를 도출한 경험이 있습니다.
  • AI 기반 구매 분석 시스템 또는 업무 자동화 솔루션을 개발·운영한 경험이 있습니다.
  • 클라우드 환경에서 데이터·AI 솔루션을 구현하거나 운영한 경험이 있습니다.
  • AI 과제의 교육, 변화 관리 및 현업 확산을 주도한 경험이 있습니다.
  • 데이터 거버넌스, 정보 보안 또는 책임 있는 AI 활용 기준을 수립·운영한 경험이 있습니다.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2. Machine Learning/Deep Learning expert

The Role –

본 직무는 한국지엠 Supply Chain 조직에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행합니다. 머신러닝 및 딥러닝 전문가로서 글로벌·지역 유관 부서와 협업하여 글로벌 공급망 시스템을 개발하고, Forecast Accuracy and Schedule Stability(FASSt) 향상을 위한 GM Korea 적용을 추진합니다.

생산 차질과 손실을 줄이고 항공 운송비, 긴급 운송 비용 및 불용 비용 등 공장 비용을 절감하며, 여러 수요 시나리오를 기반으로 전사 차원의 운영 의사결정을 지원하는 Sales & Operations Planning(S&OP) 체계를 현지 상황에 맞게 구현하고 혁신합니다.


What You’ll Do -

  • 지역별 사업 환경과 요구사항을 반영하여 FASSt 및 S&OP를 포함한 GSC AI/ML 과제의 딥러닝 솔루션을 설계·개발·검증하고 적용합니다.
  • 글로벌 공급망 시스템을 현지 사업 요구사항에 맞게 적용하고, 확장 가능한 GSC AI/ML 솔루션의 현지 구현 및 지속적인 혁신을 추진합니다.
  • Google Cloud Platform을 활용하여 시스템 모니터링, 데이터 품질 관리, 워크플로 자동화 등 GSC AI/ML 과제를 지원하는 시스템 혁신과 지속적인 개선을 추진합니다.
  • 데이터 정확성, 가시성, 운영 신뢰성 및 실행력을 향상하기 위한 표준 프로세스와 보고서를 개발합니다.
  • 부품 등록 및 시스템 데이터 업데이트를 통해 시스템 입력값을 자율적으로 유지·관리합니다.
  • 리더십의 전략과 방향성을 이해하고 팀 목표 및 우선순위에 맞춰 업무를 수행합니다.
  • 원팀 정신을 바탕으로 전반적인 공급망 성과 향상에 기여합니다.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) -

  • 공급망 환경에서 머신러닝 또는 딥러닝 솔루션을 설계·개발·검증·적용할 수 있습니다.
  • 클라우드 기반 AI/ML 플랫폼을 활용할 수 있으며, Google Cloud Platform 또는 이에 준하는 전사적 기술에 대한 이해를 보유하고 있습니다.
  • Python, JavaScript, Excel VBA 등 프로그래밍 언어 및 도구를 활용하여 프로세스를 자동화할 수 있습니다.
  • Google Cloud 전환을 포함한 신규 시스템 마이그레이션, 프로세스 변경 및 지속적인 개선 활동에 유연하게 대응할 수 있습니다.
  • 제조 환경의 공급망 운영, 프로세스 및 자재 흐름에 대한 높은 이해를 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 리더십과 주인의식을 바탕으로 업무에 대한 책임을 다할 수 있습니다.
  • 우수한 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 데이터를 분석하고 이슈 및 개선 기회를 파악하여 실질적인 해결책을 개발할 수 있습니다.
  • 업무에 대한 강한 열정과 구성원을 이끄는 리더십을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 새로운 도전과 변화에 개방적인 자세를 갖추고 있습니다.
  • 유관 부서와 효과적으로 협업할 수 있습니다.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) -

  • 머신러닝 및 딥러닝을 공급망, 수요예측, 생산계획, 제조 최적화 또는 운영 의사결정 지원에 적용한 학업·인턴십·프로젝트 경험이 있습니다.
  • Excel VBA, Python, Power BI, TensorFlow, scikit-learn 또는 이에 준하는 프로그래밍·분석 언어 및 프레임워크를 활용한 경험이 있습니다.
  • 운영 신뢰성 향상을 위한 워크플로 자동화, 데이터 파이프라인, 시스템 모니터링 및 데이터 품질 관리 경험이 있습니다.
  • 공급망, 제조, IT, 엔지니어링, 재무, 영업 및 외부 파트너가 참여하는 부문 간 혁신 과제에 대한 이해가 있습니다.
  • 예측 정확도, 생산계획 안정성, 생산 연속성, 비용 성과 및 전사적 S&OP 의사결정 향상 기회를 발굴하고 실행하는 데 관심이 있습니다.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

3. Automation Specialist

The Role –

Automation Specialist는 제조공정 개발 및 양산 준비 조직의 자동화 전략을 수립하고 실행하는 핵심 역할을 담당합니다.

자동화 엔지니어링 전문성, 전략적 소싱, 프로젝트 리더십 및 글로벌 커뮤니케이션 역량을 바탕으로 안전성, 신뢰성, 확장성 및 비용 효율성을 갖춘 제조 솔루션을 발굴하고 구현합니다. 또한 기술적·상업적 요구사항을 정의하고 소싱 전략을 수립하며, 자동화 프로그램을 콘셉트 수립부터 설계, 설치, 시운전, 가동 및 공장 운영 조직으로의 인수인계까지 전 과정에 걸쳐 관리합니다.

공장, 공급업체, 글로벌 엔지니어링 및 제조 조직 간 협업을 이끌어 자동화 프로젝트의 성공적인 실행과 지속적인 개선을 추진합니다.


What You’ll Do -

  • 제조 목표에 부합하는 자동화 전략, 중장기 로드맵 및 표준을 수립합니다.
  • AMR, AFT, AGV, ASRS, 협동로봇 및 휴머노이드 로봇 등 자동화 기술에 대한 전략적 소싱 계획을 수립합니다.
  • RFQ 작성, 공급업체 평가, 기술·상업 조건 협상, 공급업체 선정 및 계약 체결을 주도합니다.
  • 공장 및 공급업체의 OAMI(Overall Automation Maturity Index, 자동화 성숙도 지수) 평가를 수행합니다.
  • 자동화 성숙도 향상을 위한 교육, 피드백, 벤치마킹 및 개선 과제를 관리합니다.
  • 자동화 콘셉트 수립, 타당성 검토, 기술 사양 정의, 설계 검토, 설치, 시스템 기동 및 시운전을 관리합니다.
  • 자동화 설비를 검증하고 공장 운영 조직으로 안정적으로 인수인계합니다.
  • 프로젝트 범위, 일정, 예산, 품질, 리스크, 양산 준비도 및 성과를 관리합니다.
  • 제조, 엔지니어링, 구매, 품질, 안전, IT, 재무, 공장 운영, 공급망 및 글로벌 조직과의 협업을 주도합니다.
  • 자동화 기술 및 공급업체 벤치마킹을 통해 확장 가능한 솔루션을 표준화하고 글로벌 우수 사례를 공유합니다.
  • 거버넌스, 교육, 개선사항 공유 및 설비 생애주기 관리를 통해 공급업체와 사내 역량을 강화합니다.
  • 프로젝트 현황, 주요 의사결정 및 이슈를 효과적으로 보고하고 기술적·상업적·구현상의 문제 해결을 주도합니다.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) -

  • 자본 투자, 예산, 일정, 품질, 리스크, 시운전 및 검증을 포함한 프로젝트 관리 역량을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 제조 공정, 자동화 안전, 품질 및 관련 법규·규정에 대한 이해를 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 기술적·상업적 이슈를 분석하고 효과적인 해결책을 도출할 수 있습니다.
  • 공급업체 및 다양한 이해관계자와 협상하고 프로젝트를 조율할 수 있습니다.
  • 글로벌 유관 부서와 협업을 주도할 수 있는 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • 뛰어난 분석력, 주인의식 및 변화 관리 역량을 보유하고 있습니다.
  • Microsoft Office(Excel, PowerPoint, Word)를 활용할 수 있습니다.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

공통지원자격 :

- 학점: 전 학년 평점 B 학점 (3.0/4.5) 이상

- 학력: 4년제 정규 대학 이상 기졸업자(경력 2년 미만) 또는 2027년 2월 졸업 예정

-모집전공:

1. AI Tool Lead : 컴퓨터공학, 데이터과학, 공학 계열, 경영학 또는 관련 전공자

2. Machine Learning/Deep Learning expert : 컴퓨터공학, 인공지능, 소프트웨어, 데이터사이언스, 통계학, 수학, 전기·전자공학, 산업공학 등 관련 전공자

3. Automation Specialist : 자동화, 전기, 기계, 제어, 로봇, 산업공학 또는 관련 전공자

- 어학 : TOEIC 750점 이상, OPIc IM2 이상 또는 TOEIC Speaking 130 이상

* 접수 마감일 기준 2년 이내 취득한 성적만 인정

* 영어권 해외 대학 졸업자는 공인 어학 성적 제출 대상에서 제외

- 경력: 관련 분야 경험은 채용 심사 시 우대하나, 입사 시 직급·처우 산정에는 반영하지 않음

- 병역: 군필 또는 면제자

- 기타 :

* 국내외 출장 및 해외여행에 결격사유가 없고, 국내에서 합법적으로 취업할 수 있는 자

* 연수기간내에 풀타임( full-time) 으로 참여 가능한 자


How We Hire -
•  소속: General Motors Korea, GPSC

• 고용형태: 신입사원 (정규직)

• 예정 입사일: 2026년 12월 1일

•  접수마감: 2026년  11월  1일 (일) 자정까지

•  접수방법: GM Career Site  온라인 지원 및 접수 

- 이력서 또는 자기소개 포트폴리오 첨부

•  전형절차: [지원서 접수] → [서류심사] → [Phone Screen] → [Video Assessment] → [면접] → [신체검사] → [온보딩]

- AI/ML/SW 관련 포지션은 Coding Test 진행 가능


•  지원서 제출이 완료되면 입력하신 개인메일로 채용절차 진행을 위해 개인정보 동의서가 발송되오니, 개인정보 동의서까지 제출이 완료 된 이후 정상적으로 채용절차가 진행됩니다.

•  지원서 제출 후 수정 및 "지원서 철회" 후 같은 포지션으로 재지원이 불가하오니, 신중하게 검토 후 제출하시기 바랍니다.  

•  취업보호 대상자는 관련 법에 의거하여 우대합니다.

•   기재하신 지원사항 및 자격사항이 사실과 다를 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.

•   기타 궁금한 korea.recruit@gm.com 로 문의해주시기 바랍니다.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role -

GM Medical 소속 Site Medical Leader로서 부평 사업장 부속의원의 진료 및 운영 전반을 책임집니다. 또한 Global Medical Team 및 Korea Medical Team의 일원으로서 GM 한국 사업장의 의료 및 산업보건 관련 업무를 수행합니다.

jobs.title: Senior Global Planner
jobs.description:
에어리퀴드는 주요 산업(석유화학, 정유, 철강, 자동차, 신재생에너지 등)에 산업용 가스 및 관련 서비스를 제공하여 성장에 기여하고 환경 친화적인 요구를 충족시켜 왔습니다. 또한 수소에너지 등을 통해 미래 친환경 에너지 사업의 기반을 다지기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

Global Planner will play a critical role in strategic resource allocation, optimization and capacity planning within our organization. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and managing global supply planning strategies to optimize the utilization of resources, meet customer demand, and support the achievement of business objectives. Your expertise in supply chain management, demand forecasting, and capacity planning will be essential in coordinating and aligning planning activities across multiple locations and timeframes.
Global Planners will be assigned by product segment and be responsible for identification and clear articulation of global demand, supply, capacity and inventory requirements, constraints, mitigation & optimization plans defined and confirmed through the S&OP process.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Develop, execute & manage global supply planning strategies by product category, with the objective of optimizing supply chain costs, capital and reliability considering factors such as customer demand, production capacity, inventory levels, lead times, mobile asset requirements & qualified customer supply lines
  • Lead, guide & collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, operations, procurement, logistics and ALAM distribution channels, to gather demand forecasts, production plans, inventory data to support the global planning process and successfully execute supply planning strategies.
  • Conduct analysis and evaluation of demand patterns, market trends, and supply chain constraints to ensure accurate and robust global supply chain reliability.
  • Define, calculate, justify and maintain global planning parameters, such as required service factors, safety stock levels (DOI), reorder points, and lead times, based on business requirements and optimization models.
  • Manage & facilitate formalized demand planning meetings with ALAM distribution channels and provide financial analysis and justifications to support working capital requirements to ensure supply chain reliability. 
  • Coordinate with ALAM affiliates, Finite Planners and other stakeholders to align inventory, capacity and resource utilization across different locations, ensuring optimal production and distribution strategies.

The primary focus of the Engineering department is to lead and execute large, mid size capital projects and smaller continuous improvement projects related to commercial chemical manufacturing processes. The process engineer will act as the central process engineering subject matter expert and perform/manage all aspects of process engineering activity for the projects executed in support of major product lines and manufacturing areas, providing technical insights, leadership, and disciplined project management for implementation of chemical process intensive projects.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

● Provide Process Engineering and Technical leadership for capital projects.
● Troubleshoot problems in manufacturing processes
● Improve the safety of existing manufacturing installations
● Identify and implement methods for manufacturing cost reduction in line with
business needs
● Provide process engineering expertise across various product lines and sites
● Develop practical solutions to complex technical problems
● Document and communicate institutional knowledge throughout the organization
● Make quantitative, fact-based decisions
● Actively engage with the project manager to ensure projects are on time, on budget, deliver the required quality
● Develop training materials for Operations technicians. Participate in the technician qualification process by providing classroom instruction on basic principles,
troubleshooting and process specifics.

  • BS or MS in Chemical Engineering

● 13 or greater years of experience designing, commissioning and starting up
chemical plants, performing hands-on optimization of specialty
chemicals/gases production units
● Demonstrated project planning and management expertise
● Proven track record of delivering on commitments
● Proven ability to lead change, personally adaptable, and able to perform well under pressure and constantly changing priorities
● Solution/outcome oriented in an environment with minimal supervision

● Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals
● Ability to fluently speak in English and Korean.
● Problem solving and decision making skills
● Excellent verbal and written communication skills
● Working knowledge of PLC and DCS control systems
● Process hazard analysis leadership; LOPA and HAZOP

jobs.description:

Within the framework of the R&D strategy and roadmap, support or perform research projects in labs, whatever the research subject, in order to develop technologies and innovations for our internal and external clients.
Lab could be considered as internal Lab or external partnerships (eg. universities, start-ups)

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Job description:

Development of novel organometallic or silicon-based compounds (including synthesis, purification, and analysis) for ALD/CVD thin film processing.

Company and team:

Air Liquide (AL) has been the world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and health since 1902. Currently AL is present in 80 countries with more than 66,000 employees. This position will be for a researcher of Metal Oxides and Nitrides group in Air Liquide Laboratories Korea (Seoul). He/she will be responsible for synthesizing new organometallic precursors for ALD/CVD technology and developing cutting-edge technologies for the semiconductor industry. The researcher will work in a multicultural environment and closely with internal and external customers and partners.

Required skills:

We are seeking a skilled chemist with extensive experience in the design, synthesis and purification of organometallic and/or silicon-based compounds.

The main responsibilities will be:

  • Design and synthesis of organometallic and/or silicon-based compounds and purification

  • Analysis using NMR, TGA, DSC, mass spectrometry, etc.

  • Timely and concise reporting (R&D reports, patent applications, internal meetings, customer meetings, etc.)

  • Lead and organize the tasks within work packages/project

  • Mentoring junior scientists and interns

  • Support interactions within Air Liquide group and with other customers

  • Join the safety activities

Are you a MATCH?

  • Minimum: Related M.S degree with 3-5 year experience

  • English: Business Proficient

  • Korean: Conversation level is a plus.

  • Fully autonomous scientist

  • Being experienced in handling pyrophoric, toxic, and combustible materials is a strong asset; the chemist would need to timely learn if not experienced

Preferred Requirements

  • Ph.D with some additional experience or Postdoc

  • Korean: Conversational level

  • Experience in CVD/ALD is preferred

  • Experience in a private or academic R&D lab handling gases is preferred

  • Application → Interview(s) → Offer proposal → Employment contract → Onboarding

  • Applicants must not have any restrictions that disqualify them from overseas travel.

  • Foreign nationals must have residency status that permits employment activities in South Korea.

  • The company reserves the right to withdraw the offer if it discovers subsequently that a candidate has given false information in application or has provided false or fraudulent documentation in support of his/her application.

jobs.description:

Our company provides nationwide home therapy services (such as Sleep Apnea, Long Term Oxygen, Home Mechanical Ventilation and other therapies) by renting our group's validated medical devices. Our company's personalized patient care management, clinical experience among employees, and nation-wide presence are key differentiators for receiving patient therapy prescription referrals from physicians at hospitals.
The Marketing Manager, Home Healthcare, will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to drive patient acquisition, value-based and patient-centric service, and market share growth for our home therapies in respiratory and other diseases in South Korea.

This role will focus on reaching patients with chronic respiratory and other diseases (e.g., COPD, NMD, sleep apnea) and their caregivers, as well as building strong relationships with healthcare professionals and key stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of how service is valued, the South Korean healthcare landscape, strong digital marketing expertise, and a passion for improving the lives of patients with chronic respiratory conditions.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with pulmonologists, respiratory therapists, ENT doctors, neurologists and other healthcare professionals.

  • Organize and participate in medical conferences, seminars, and workshops.

  • Develop and distribute educational materials for healthcare professionals.

Digital Marketing & Content Creation:

  • Develop and manage digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including SEO/SEM, social media, email marketing, and online advertising. 

  • Create engaging and informative content for websites, social media, and marketing materials, tailored to the South Korean audience.

  • Manage and optimize the company's online presence, including website and online patient portals.

Key Opinion Leader of HealthCare Professional Engagement: (while Sales manager is responsible for developing/ managing HeathCareProfessionals)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with pulmonologists, respiratory therapists, ENT doctors, neurologists and other healthcare professionals.

  • Organize and participate in medical conferences, seminars, and workshops.

  • Develop and distribute educational materials for healthcare professionals.

Patient & Caregiver Engagement:

  • Develop and implement patient education programs and support initiatives.

  • Create and manage patient advocacy programs and online communities.

  • Organize and participate in patient outreach events and health fairs.

Brand Management & Communication:

  • Ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across all marketing channels.

  • Develop and manage public relations activities and media relations.

  • Monitor and manage online reputation.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

  • Generate regular reports and presentations to communicate marketing results to management.

  • Utilize CRM software to manage leads and patient interactions.

Compliance:

  • Ensure all marketing activities comply with South Korean healthcare regulations and ethical guidelines.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 7+years of marketing experience, preferably in respiratory care or other home healthcare.  

  • Strong understanding of the South Korean healthcare market and regulatory environment.

  • Proven track records of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns.

  • Excellent digital marketing skills, including SEO (Search Engine Optimization)/ SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media, and content marketing.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with healthcare professionals and patients.  

  • Fluency in Korean and English (both written and spoken).

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and AI (Gemini) is preferred

  • People Management experience is preferred

Located in Asia, preferably in Korea or Japan

  • Guides creation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for those products together with Operations, Engineering, and technical development organizations

  • Strong skills in multitasking, organization and planning to manage ever changing priorities. Capable of handling several projects in parallel

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Air Liquide Advanced Materials (ALAM) is transforming the science of electronics and technology. We innovate with atomic scale engineering to open up countless new possibilities in how the world lives, works and connects. Today, our ALOHATM and Voltaix® products are critical to the manufacture of the newest computer chips required for Big Data and the Internet of Things. To enhance our execution from discovery to delivery we are adding talented people to our team.

Prevents Equipment Failures utilising data and digital tools and accepted Failure Analysis Methodology Originates and develops analysis methods to determine reliability of components, equipment and processes. Acquires and analyzes data. Prepares diagrams, charts, drawings, calculations and reports to define reliability problems and make recommendations for improvements. Conducts analysis of reliability problems and investigates to determine the required reliability approach for a particular situation, with consideration given to cost limitations for equipment uptime/downtime, repair/replacement costs and weight, size and availability of materials/equipment. Determines cost advantages of alternatives and develops action plans that comply with internal/external customer demands for reliable processes/equipment to avoid failures.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Gather and examine basic reliability data from field studies or database/equipment history and correlate the data for analysis using well-defined engineering techniques, principles and procedures, develop gap analysis and propose improvement plans.

  • Analyze entities’ reliability performance and communicate gaps and progress of entities to the country managers/Operations director and Cluster management team

  • Leads and assists others actively in Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCA) to avoid future failures and follow-up on actions identified and provide RCA training 

  • Prioritize and follow-up and close critical reliability initiatives/programs by the Group

  • Determine critical spare parts and appropriate stocking levels.

  • Responsible for the entity Technical Review meeting and Champion the reliability program not limited to using interlex reliability information to work on the analysis; develop statistical analysis dashboard and implement the program based on the analysis.  

  • Provide appropriate metrics e.g.: Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) & etc. 

  • Participate in plant shutdowns to improve knowledge and assist in operational troubleshooting. 

  • Adherence to Job Order / Work Permit system and to maintain zero accident by complying to all Safety rules & regulations in accordance with Air Liquide IMS and Workplace Safety & Health Act.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Degree in Mechanical/Instrumentation/Chemical/Electrical or related Engineering field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in maintenance / service / commissioning in the Oil and Gas or petrochemical industry especially in electrical, instrumentation, and control.

  • Possesses a Continuous Improvement mindset.

  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis methodology and Failure Modes. 

  • Experience in Asset management is an advantage

  • This role will be remunerated based on the domestic package.

jobs.title: Specialty Gas (SG) ID Manager
jobs.description:
Air Liquide began operations in Malaysia in 1927 and is one of the pioneers of the gas industry in Malaysia. Operating in 11 locations in Malaysia, comprising both sales offices and production facilities, Air Liquide supports our customers through providing innovative solutions at every step of their production, including industrial and specialty gases, energy solutions, application technologies and services. With a strong workforce of 400 employees and business growth through our recent acquisition with nationwide presence, this will provide an exciting experience and journey with the opportunity that is unique yet challenging to gauge the integration and synergy processes that will change the entire competition landscape in Malaysia.

Summary:
The Specialty Gas Manager acts as the bridge between Group strategies and local operations. The core mission is to drive industrial performance, ensure strict compliance with Group standards for Specialty Gases (SG), and serve as the Business Process Owner (BPO) to optimize workflows and asset utilization across the cluster.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Collaborate with the Cluster Packaged Gas team to drive the Cluster’s industrial performance strategy, ensuring strict adherence to the PMS framework, governance, and reporting standards while leading regular performance reviews to meet Group-aligned targets.

  • Oversee the quality implementation of corrective actions and mandatory programs, ensuring key lessons are documented and shared, while actively collaborating with the Cluster team to secure funding for critical Group Industrial Initiatives.

  • Drive the strategic planning process by acting as the technical authority for some entities’ assets, proactively managing asset renewal and asset extension lifetime studies, and assessing equipment utilization rates to propose such as reallocation plans that optimize Cluster’s resources.

  • Lead the end-to-end management of selected Cluster industrial projects—from aligning with the entities on project selection to collecting subsidiary specifications—while supervising the execution of core missions to ensure they meet industrial and business performance targets.

  • Collaborate with procurement and global entities to optimize the total landed cost and reliability of raw material and product supply chains at EAP boundaries, while defining weekly/monthly (S&OE) and annual (S&OP) planning to support strategic planning.

  • Supervise the execution of core missions, monitoring their impact on industrial performance and setting action plans accordingly.

  • Maximize profitability within EAP boundaries by jointly reviewing entity setups and trading product portfolios, while actively monitoring asset profitability across Business Lines to propose and drive improvement plans.

  • Collaborate with procurement and the operations controller to define long-term third-party sourcing strategies, commercial development plans, and precise landed cost allocations (localizing Group policies) to establish minimum costing guidelines.

  • Lead the deployment of standards, mandatory SG programs, and the digital roadmap across the Cluster, acting as the Business Process Owner to steer implementation, close compliance gaps, and ensure strict adherence to Group policies for assets and processes.

  • Drive knowledge transfer and competency development through field coaching and engage expert support to subsidiaries, while closely collaborating with entities and global stakeholders to implement technical standards and value initiatives.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Degree in Chemical Engineering or relevant discipline. 

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations or industrial direction, with a specific focus on Specialty Gases within the industrial gas sector.

  • In-depth understanding of industrial gas processes, specifically in manufacturing and logistics, utilizing a holistic end-to-end perspective.

  • Proficient in navigating modern operating models, utilizing digital tools, and leveraging data for decision-making.

  • Knowledge of energy management principles would be an advantage.

  • Proven track record in driving transformation programs and effectively managing associated organizational change.

  • Robust project management capabilities with a focus on delivery and execution.

  • Demonstrated strong leadership skills with the ability to develop, articulate, and present a compelling strategic vision based on end-to-end thinking.

  • Strong customer acumen, ensuring industrial strategies align with customer needs and market demands.

  • This role will be remunerated based on the domestic package.

jobs.title: 대산 고압 수소 출하센터 상시 채용
jobs.description:
How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

롯데케미컬과 에어리퀴드코리아가 함께 설립한 "롯데 에어리퀴드 에너하이" (이하 에너하이)에서 대산 고압 수소 출하 센터를 2025년 하반기에 출범할 예정입니다.
친환경 수소 에너지의 미래를 함께할 여러분의 참여를 기다립니다.

본 채용은 상시 채용 공고로 상시 모집을 통하여 일정기간 동안 지원 기회를 열어두어, 이력서를 미리 받아놓은 뒤, 향후 해당 부문 인재 채용 필요시, 적합한 지원자분과 다음 채용 프로세스를 진행하는 방식입니다. 해당 방식은 바로 채용이 진행되지 않더라도 지속적으로 입사 지원을 받으며, 이력서를 등록해주시면 향후, 해당 부문에 채용을 진행하게 될 경우, 연락드릴 예정입니다.

1) 생산직 (Shift Operator)

- 생산 계획에 따른 튜브 트레일러 충전, 입출고 검사 및 설비 운영.
- 생산 공정 관리 및 월간 생산 관리.
- 생산 관련 데이터 및 보고서 관리
- 공장 유지보수 및 안전 관리 
 

2) 생산직 리더 (Shift Operator Leader)

- 공장 신뢰성 및 효율성 개선, 장비 교정 스케줄 관리, SOP 관리 및 안전작업허가서 발행.

- 장비 유지보수 지원 및 안전장비 점검 & 관리

- 관련 규정 준수, KGS 및 KOSHA 정기 안전점검 지원(PSM/ SMS).

- 그룹 Audit 지원 및 문서 업데이트.

3) 전기계장 엔지니어 (Electrical & Instrument Engineer )

- 유지보수 계획, 예비 부품, 예산 검토를 통한 유지보수 전략 기획
- 주요 장비 및 시설 유지보수 및 TAR 활동 지원
- 주요 이벤트에 대한 RCA 검토 및 해결방법 모색 및 계획
- 안전 규정 준수를 바탕으로 개선점 식별 및 실행

___________________

Are you a MATCH?

1) 생산직 & 생산직 리더

- 전문대졸 이상 (화학, 기계, 전기 공학 전공자 우대)

- 유관 경력 1년 이상 보유자

- 가스기능사, 기사, 위험물산업기사, 대기환경기사 자격증 보유자 우대

- 근무형태: 4조 3교대 또는 4조 2교대

2) 전기계장 엔지니어

-학사 졸업 이상 : 공학 계열 전공자 ( 전기 및 계측 공학 전공자 우대)

- 유관 경력 5년 이상 보유자 

- 자격증: 전기안전관리자 또는 전기기사 또는 전기산업기사 보유자

- 영어 커뮤니케이션 가능자 우대

The Transportation Specialist is responsible for managing day-to-day transportation operations, including oversight of third-party vendors and freight forwarders. The specialist will monitor performance, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate cross-functionally to enhance service levels and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and oversee daily transportation activities
  • Manage relationships with 3M vendors, carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers.
  • Ensure timely delivery performance and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Monitor shipment status, proactively resolving delays, disruptions, or service issues.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for carriers/transportation vendors and freight forwarders locally.
  • Serve as the key transportation contact for material vendors/suppliers to coordinate shipment readiness, collection planning, and issue resolution
  • Evaluate vendor performance using KPIs such as on-time material readiness, cost, and service quality.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with transportation regulations, trade requirements, and company policies.
  • Review shipping documentation for accuracy (e.g., bills of lading, customs paperwork, invoices).

  • Monitor continuous improvement using metrics, root cause analysis, and best practices.
  • Monitor freight spend and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for transportation expenses.
  • Ensure cost-effective transportation solutions without compromising service quality.
  • Work closely with supply chain, vendors, procurement, and customer service teams.
  • Align transportation strategies with business needs and customer expectations.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Experience managing carriers, freight forwarders, or 3PL providers.

  • 10% of domestic travel to visit local suppliers.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.).
  • Familiarity with KPI development and performance reporting.

Key Competencies

  • Transportation management
  • Data analysis and decision-making
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience in deformable body mechanics

  • Fundamental understanding of soft matter physics and mechanical behavior and polymer synthesis/structure

  • Must have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to excel in cross-functional environments

  • Must be highly motivated, self-starting and a creative problem solver

By supporting customers at the resin screening and process development stage as well as at commercial manufacturing, this role builds early technical influence and secures resin and column design-in. It delivers expert-assured reproducibility, increased process uptime and consistent confidence in packed bed performance for customers running GMP production.

This position reports to the BioProcess Hardware Modality Leader, Korea and is part of the Bioprocessing organization located in Korea, working remotely to cover customers across Korea.

  • Execute column packing and unpacking across all scales:

- Lab / development scale — Tricorn, HiScale, XK and comparable columns supporting customer resin screening, method development and process development activities.

- Pilot scale — AxiChrom 50–200 mm, BPG, Fineline and equivalent columns.

- Process scale — AxiChrom and Chromaflow columns at customer GMP sites.

  • Qualify packed beds against agreed acceptance criteria (HETP, asymmetry), document results, and issue packing reports that customers can use as part of their manufacturing records.
  • Support customer resin screening and process development activities by packing small-scale columns to consistent, documented specifications — enabling reliable scale-down model performance and generating packing data that supports subsequent scale-up.

  • Support customer issues involving the interaction between resin and columns, including troubleshooting performance deviations, packed-bed behavior, resin handling, column hardware conditions and scale-related issues in collaboration with modality, application and global technical teams.
  • Ensure scale-up consistency by translating packing parameters established at lab and pilot scale (compression factor, packing flow velocity, bed height) into validated process-scale packing methods, and by advising customers on the scale-up implications of resin and column selection.
  • Train and certify customer operators across scales — covering lab-scale packing technique for process development groups, and process-scale packing, unpacking, CIP and routine handling for manufacturing operators — at customer sites and demo centers.
  • Act as technical escalation point for packing-related issues, engaging global product, R&D, quality and service teams to investigate and close complex cases such as bed instability, channeling, repeat repacking and resin damage.

Who you are:

  • Multiple years of hands-on experience in bioprocess downstream operations, with direct experience packing chromatography columns at both laboratory / pilot scale and process scale.

Job Title

Job Description

Company Introduction

130여년 전 네덜란드에서 시작된 필립스는 헬스 테크놀로지 분야 선도 기업으로, 사람들이 더욱 건강한 삶과 웰빙(well-being)을 영위하도록 건강한 생활에서부터 질병의 예방, 조기 진단, 치료 과정 내 관리에 이르는 헬스케어 전 과정(Health Continuum)에서 전방위적 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다. 특히, 선진 기술력에 임상 및 소비자 분야에서 쌓은 인사이트를 더해 통합적인 솔루션을 제시하는데 주력하고 있습니다.

필립스코리아는 1976년 한국 법인을 설립한 후, 지난 50년간 한국 소비자에게 의미 있는 혁신을 제공하고 삶의 질을 향상시키며 지속 가능한 사회를 만들고자 노력해 왔습니다.

필립스코리아는 Diagnosis & Treatment(영상 진단 및 치료), Connected Care(환자 모니터링/분석 및 수면 호흡기 질환 케어), Personal Health(남성 그루밍, 뷰티, 구강건강 및 육아용 솔루션) 시장을 선도하고 있습니다.

Job Title

Market Procurement Manager

 

Role Summary:

As the Procurement representative for Korea, this role leads end-to-end procurement activities, including strategic sourcing, commercial negotiations, contracting, supplier selection, and supplier performance management.

In addition to the Korea market responsibilities, the role manages key mechanical suppliers, driving cost competitiveness, quality and delivery performance, and supply risk mitigation.

The role also supports the Personal Health business by identifying and assessing potential suppliers in Korea, including manufacturers, component suppliers, and technology partners, to meet product, cost, and supply chain requirements.

Working closely with local business teams and global stakeholders, the role ensures supplier compliance, supply continuity, and continuous improvement across these responsibilities.

 
Key Areas of Responsibilities:


1. Korea Market Procurement

  • Act as the senior Procurement representative for Korea and lead end-to-end sourcing, commercial negotiation, contracting and supplier decisions for complex third-party products and services.
  • Influence Korea leadership, Business Market Leaders, Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Legal, Finance and global procurement teams to translate competing business needs into integrated sourcing strategies and decisions.
  • Build and maintain a short- and mid-term productivity pipeline through competitive sourcing, supplier consolidation, Design-For-Excellence (DfX), demand challenge and total-cost-of-ownership analysis.
  • Balance project-based procurement with category management and promote approved, standardized and catalog solutions where appropriate.
  • Safeguard assurance of supply, delivery reliability and customer commitments through proactive supplier risk management and contingency planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Korean regulations, Philips Quality Management Systems, cybersecurity requirements, master agreements and internal procurement policies.
  • Monitor supplier performance, address recurring gaps and drive corrective actions with the relevant stakeholders.
  • Shape and implement procurement operating-model and process improvements that can be scaled across categories or markets where relevant.

 

2. Mechanical Supplier Account Management

  • Own the commercial relationship and account strategy for an assigned portfolio of strategically important Mechanical suppliers, acting as the senior point of contact for supplier-related commercial alignment.
  • Develop and execute supplier account strategies aligned with category, business and supplier priorities, covering cost and feature competitiveness, performance, technology roadmaps, innovation, sustainability, capacity and risk.
  • Manage supplier performance using the applicable scorecards and cross-functional calibration, with clear improvement actions for quality, delivery, productivity and sustainability.
  • Lead negotiations, business reviews, contract management and sourcing events using Philips standards and tools.
  • Create competitive tension through benchmarking, market intelligence, supplier capability assessment and alternative-source development.
  • Coordinate supplier-related activities across Procurement, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Operations and business stakeholders to maintain one consistent Philips position.
  • Identify financial, operational, regulatory and continuity risks and establish mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Encourage suppliers to contribute design-to-cost, Lean, total-cost and innovation opportunities.

 

3. Personal Health Supplier Scouting

  • Work with Personal Health procurement and business stakeholders to convert product, technology, capacity, localization and cost needs into a clear supplier search brief and selection criteria.
  • Map and research the Korean supplier ecosystem, including contract manufacturers, component suppliers and technology partners relevant to Personal Health products.
  • Build a qualified longlist and shortlist using market research, industry networks, trade shows, supplier databases and referrals from category and technical experts.
  • Lead market engagement, confidentiality arrangements, requests for information, capability screening and the commercial workstream through supplier selection.
  • Coordinate commercial, technical, quality, sustainability, regulatory and financial assessments with the relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Evaluate supplier readiness, strategic fit, willingness to invest, scalability, cost competitiveness, localization potential and business continuity risk.
  • Maintain a transparent scouting pipeline, document inclusion and exclusion rationale, and prepare sourcing recommendations for decision boards.
  • Lead the procurement contribution through qualification, contracting, onboarding and early supplier development while maintaining clear ownership across Procurement, Supplier Quality and Engineering.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business or a related field. A mechanical or other technical engineering background is preferred.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience across direct procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier account management, supplier development or procurement project management in a multinational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in commercial negotiation, requests for proposal, contract management, total-cost analysis and supplier performance management.
  • Experience sourcing engineered products, mechanical parts or assemblies, contract manufacturing, equipment or installation and repair services.
  • Ability to assess suppliers beyond price, including technical capability, quality systems, capacity, financial health, sustainability, regulatory readiness and continuity risk.
  • Knowledge of regulated industries such as MedTech, healthcare, life sciences or high-tech manufacturing is preferred. Consumer products experience is an advantage for the Personal Health scope.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior local and global stakeholders, lead cross-functional decisions without direct authority and maintain alignment through conflict or ambiguity.
  • Working proficiency in Korean and English, including supplier negotiations, presentations and written communication.
  • Proven ability to operate independently, make sound decisions under ambiguity and lead multiple high-impact workstreams with limited supervision.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, project management or design-to-cost certification is beneficial.

 

About Philips:

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business.
• Discover our rich and exciting history.
• Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here.

 

Find more information about what we provide for employee benefits.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Communications and Brand Senior Manager, Korea and APAC

Job Description

About Philips and the opportunity 

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. As a global leader in health technology, we help deliver better care for more people through solutions that improve patient outcomes, enhance clinical productivity, and expand access to quality healthcare. 

Communications and brand are critical enablers of this vision. They build trust, strengthen reputation, elevate thought leadership, and support business growth by positioning Philips as a leading partner in healthcare transformation. 


We are seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial, and future-focused Manager, Communications & Brand to lead communications and brand activities across Korea, Thailand, and Vietnam, while serving as the Communications & Brand Business Partner for one of Philips' businesses across APAC. 

The role will shape reputation, drive stakeholder engagement, enhance executive visibility, and deliver integrated communications strategies that advance business priorities. The successful candidate will combine strategic communications expertise with a strong understanding of healthcare and the evolving role of artificial intelligence, using both to strengthen Philips' leadership in health technology and innovation. 

As the communications lead for Korea, you will partner closely with country leadership, business teams, and regional and global colleagues. 

 
Job Title: Communications and Brand Senior Manager, Korea and APAC

Location: Seoul
Reports to: Head of Communications and Brand, APAC


Your Role 

 

Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership 

  • Serve as a trusted communications and brand advisor to country leadership and APAC business leaders, providing strategic counsel on reputation, executive visibility, thought leadership, stakeholder engagement, and business transformation. 
  • Partner with leadership teams to align communications strategies with business objectives, growth priorities, customer engagement, and market opportunities. 
  • Identify communications opportunities and risks and recommending strategies that strengthen Philips' reputation and market leadership. 
  • Represent Communications & Brand as a strategic business partner, ensuring initiatives contribute to business outcomes, stakeholder trust, and organizational success. 
  • Advise leaders on communicating Philips' innovation agenda, including AI-enabled healthcare solutions, in a credible, meaningful, and stakeholder-relevant way. 

Reputation, Brand & Thought Leadership 

  • Develop and execute integrated communications and brand strategies that strengthen Philips' reputation and position the company as a trusted leader in healthcare innovation. 
  • Drive thought leadership on critical healthcare topics, including AI, clinical innovation, workforce challenges, sustainability, and access to care. 
  • Build executive visibility platforms for senior leaders across healthcare, technology, policy, and business communities. 
  • Ensure consistent application of Philips' brand identity, messaging, and corporate narrative across channels and stakeholder interactions. 

Strategic Storytelling & Media Relations 

  • Lead strategic storytelling that translates complex healthcare technologies, customer impact, and innovation into compelling narratives. 
  • Identify and develop stories showing how Philips improves patient care, supports clinicians, and transforms healthcare delivery. 
  • Build strong relationships with healthcare, business, technology, and mainstream media and lead proactive engagement that strengthens visibility, influence, and trust. 
  • Develop high-quality executive communications, media materials, social content, customer stories, videos, speeches, articles, and employee communications. 

AI-Enabled Communications Innovation 

  • Champion responsible adoption of AI-enabled communications practices to enhance audience insight, stakeholder engagement, content effectiveness, and operational efficiency. 
  • Use AI-powered tools and analytics for content development, social listening, reputation monitoring, trend analysis, campaign optimization, and performance measurement. 
  • Identify emerging technologies and innovative approaches that improve communications impact, scale, and effectiveness. 
  • Partner with business leaders to communicate Philips' AI innovation story responsibly and effectively. 
  • Foster continuous learning and experimentation while applying human judgment, quality control, and governance. 

Issues, Crisis & Reputation Management 

  • Monitor the external environment to identify emerging issues, reputational risks, and opportunities. 
  • Advise leadership on issues and crisis communications strategies and support timely, effective response planning. 
  • Collaborate with legal, regulatory, quality, and business teams to ensure aligned communications during sensitive situations. 
  • Protect and strengthen Philips' reputation through proactive stakeholder engagement and effective risk communications. 

Campaigns, Employee Communications & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Lead integrated communications campaigns across earned, owned, shared, and internal channels. 
  • Drive communications for product launches, customer partnerships, innovation announcements, and strategic initiatives. 
  • Develop employee communications that foster engagement, alignment, and connection to Philips' purpose, strategy, and culture. 
  • Collaborate across global, regional, and local teams and manage external agencies and partners to deliver high-quality, measurable outcomes. 

Measurement & Continuous Improvement 

  • Establish meaningful KPIs and measurement frameworks demonstrating contribution to business priorities, stakeholder engagement, and reputation. 
  • Use data, analytics, and AI-driven insights to evaluate effectiveness and continuously optimize performance. 
  • Champion communications innovation and best practices across the region. 

 

You're the right fit if

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, corporate affairs, public relations, brand, or marketing communications, ideally within healthcare, health technology, life sciences, or a multinational organization. 
  • Proven experience providing strategic communications counsel to senior leaders and business executives. 
  • Strong track record in integrated communications, reputation management, media relations, thought leadership, executive communications, and issues or crisis management. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively in a complex, matrixed, multinational environment. 
  • Strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, policy landscape, and media environment in Korea; experience across APAC markets is advantageous. 
  • Experience using digital tools, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve communications effectiveness and stakeholder engagement. 
  • Understanding of the opportunities and implications of AI in healthcare, with the ability to translate complex innovation into compelling and accessible narratives. 
  • Exceptional storytelling, content development, stakeholder engagement, strategic thinking, and business acumen. 
  • Self-starter able to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a dynamic environment. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or a related discipline. 
  • Fluent in Korean and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

What success looks like

  • Stronger reputation and stakeholder trust in priority markets 
  • Greater executive visibility and thought leadership influence 
  • High-impact customer, innovation, and healthcare transformation storytelling 
  • Clear contribution to strategic business priorities and market growth 
  • Stronger employee alignment and engagement 
  • Responsible use of AI and data-driven insight to improve communications effectiveness 
  • Enhanced Philips leadership in healthcare innovation across Korea, ASEAN, and APAC 

How we work together:

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

Field Service Engineer, Daegu

Job Description

필립스코리아는 1976년 한국 법인을 설립한 후, 지난 50년간 한국 소비자에게 의미 있는 혁신을 제공하고 삶의 질을 향상시키며 지속 가능한 사회를 만들고자 노력해 왔습니다.

필립스코리아는 Diagnosis & Treatment(영상 진단 및 치료), Connected Care(환자 모니터링/분석 및 수면 호흡기 질환 케어), Personal Health(남성 그루밍, 뷰티, 구강건강 및 육아용 솔루션) 시장을 선도하고 있습니다.

 

• Philips 채용 정보

• Philips - Better care for more people
• Why work at Philips?

 

Job Title

Field Service Engineer

 

About Position:

  • Business: Health Systems, Customer Service
  • Location: Daegu, Korea (대구)

 

Role Summary:

The Field Service Engineer provides frontline technical support, both onsite and remotely, focusing on maintenance, basic repairs, and installation of products and services under close to general supervision.

The role develops technical expertise by applying diagnostic and troubleshooting techniques to resolve routine product issues and support senior engineers with more complex cases. Work is primarily performed at customer sites while following established procedures and regulatory requirements.

The position also supports continuous improvement through product knowledge development, application of best practices, and delivery of service excellence aligned with organizational standards and customer expectations.

 

Field Service Engineer는 필립스 HealthTech 제품의 설치 및 유지보수, 기술 지원과 서비스 딜리버리를 통해 고객 만족도를 극대화하고 필립스의 가치를 제공하는 역할을 합니다. 업무는 주로 고객 현장에서 수행되며, 필요에 따라 원격 기술 지원을 제공하고 제품의 고장 진단 및 문제 해결, 기본적인 수리, 예방 유지보수, 업그레이드 및 설치 업무를 수행합니다. 이 과정에서 정해진 절차와 관련 규정을 준수하며, 타 팀 및 선임 엔지니어와의 기술적인 협업을 통해 복잡한 문제를 해결합니다. 또한 담당 제품에 대한 전문성을 지속적으로 개발하고, 모범 사례를 적용하며, 서비스 품질 및 업무 프로세스의 개선 기회를 발굴하여 조직의 기준과 고객의 기대에 부합하는 우수한 서비스를 제공하는 데 기여합니다.

 
Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Provide onsite and remote technical support and maintenance services, including troubleshooting, repairs, upgrades, and installation of products and services while complying with regulatory requirements and company standards.
  • Document service activities and findings, including diagnostics, resolution steps, testing procedures, and case status updates, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and effective knowledge sharing.
  • Work under limited supervision and established processes, exercising independent judgment to ensure compliance and consistent service quality.
  • Track and record service activities, customer interaction time, parts usage, and service outcomes accurately and in real time to support operational efficiency and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare thoroughly for service visits by diagnosing potential issues, organizing required parts, and developing structured action plans to maximize first-time fix rates and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage customer escalations, complaints, and feedback by coordinating timely and effective solutions for both routine and complex issues.
  • Execute moderately complex to complex field service activities using diagnostic tools and troubleshooting techniques to ensure reliable product performance.
  • Support business growth by identifying upgrade opportunities, potential sales leads, and value-added services during customer interactions.
  • Continuously develop technical expertise in assigned products and services while identifying opportunities to improve service delivery and customer support.

 

  • 관련 규정 및 회사 표준을 준수하면서 제품 및 서비스의 문제 해결, 수리, 업그레이드, 설치 등을 포함한 현장 및 원격 기술 지원과 유지보수 서비스를 제공합니다.
  • 진단 결과, 문제 해결 과정, 테스트 절차 및 케이스 진행 상태 등 서비스 활동과 결과를 문서화하여 정확성과 추적 가능성을 확보하고, 관련 지식이 효과적으로 공유될 수 있도록 합니다.
  • 제한적인 감독하에 정해진 절차에 따라 업무를 수행하며, 독립적인 판단을 통해 규정 준수와 일관된 서비스 품질을 유지합니다.
  • 운영 효율성 향상 및 지속적인 개선을 위해 서비스 활동, 고객 응대 시간, 부품 사용 내역 및 서비스 결과를 정확하게 실시간으로 기록하고 관리합니다.
  • 최초 방문 시 문제를 해결하는 비율(First-Time Fix Rate)과 고객 만족도를 높이기 위해 서비스 방문 전에 잠재적인 문제를 진단하고, 필요한 부품을 준비하며, 체계적인 조치 계획을 수립합니다.
  • 일반적인 문제부터 복잡한 문제까지 고객의 에스컬레이션, 불만 및 피드백을 관리하고, 신속하고 효과적인 해결책을 마련하기 위해 관련 부서와 협업합니다.
  • 진단 도구와 문제 해결 기법을 활용하여 중간 수준부터 복잡한 수준까지의 현장 서비스 업무를 수행하고, 제품의 안정적인 성능을 보장합니다.
  • 고객과의 접점에서 업그레이드 기회, 잠재적인 영업 기회 및 부가가치 서비스를 발굴하여 비즈니스 성장에 기여합니다.

  • Equivalent qualifications obtained through high school or vocational education.

or equivalent experience.

Company Introduction

필립스코리아는 1976년 한국 법인을 설립한 후, 지난 50년간 한국 소비자에게 의미 있는 혁신을 제공하고 삶의 질을 향상시키며 지속 가능한 사회를 만들고자 노력해 왔습니다.

필립스코리아는 Diagnosis & Treatment(영상 진단 및 치료), Connected Care(환자 모니터링/분석 및 수면 호흡기 질환 케어), Personal Health(남성 그루밍, 뷰티, 구강건강 및 육아용 솔루션) 시장을 선도하고 있습니다.


• Philips 채용 정보

• Why work at Philips?

• Position title: Sales Account Manager

• Location: Seoul, Korea


In this role, you have the opportunity to

해당 포지션은 Philips의 Customer Account 관리를 담당하는 Account Manager로서, 고객의 전략과 시장 동향을 깊이 이해하여 단기 및 장기적인 비즈니스 가치를 극대화하고, 고객과의 신뢰 있는 관계를 기반으로 영업 기회를 창출하는 역할을 수행합니다.
Modality Sales, Marketing, Service, Supply Chain 등 내부 팀과 협업하여 One Philips 접근 방식으로 Account 전략 및 비즈니스 성장 계획을 수립하고 실행합니다.
지속적인 프로세스 개선을 추진하며, Funnel 관리 및 시장 점유율 확대를 통해 매출 성과를 극대화합니다.


Key Areas of Responsibilities

  • Develop and drive a credible and productive long-term relation with customers to maximize the value (top- and bottom-line) of the short & long term business with the account for Philips based on the deep understanding of customers strategies and priorities external trends, market insights on industry trends, competitive landscape, legislation.
  • Coordinate efficient One Philips approach to the customer, by working with Sales, Marketing, Service, Supply Chain team members at account.
  • Develop Account Strategy aligned with the Customer’s priorities, and drive key account customer Sales Plans to fulfill account plan growth.
  • Drives continuous improvement via Lean & CFSS methodology .
  • Maintain and grow comparable sales and market share & share of wallet.
  • Funnel Management via daily management methodology.
  • Strategy account management – orchestrator of accounts with 360 team members.
  • Develop, maintain and improve of the relations a limited number of key accounts to keep or to set Philips as preferred supplier.
  • Initializing and coordinating all Philips efforts to the accounts in order to maximize the output of the sales group.
  • Act as single point for customers as account manager for smaller / transactional accounts in the Market, prepares and delivers on the tactical account plans.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above.
  • Over 7 years of healthcare sales experience is required.
  • Highly motivated, customer-focused professional with a proven track record of building strong customer relationships, driving business growth, and delivering results in the healthcare industry.
  • Related experience in Radiology or Cardiology area preferred.
  • Experience in building and executing account strategy and CRM preferred.
  • Passionate and motivated mindset to boost the sales and overcome business challenge.
  • Winning sprit mindset, resilience, and ability to influence colleagues.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skill.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

Job Title

Clinical Application Specialist, IGT-S (Busan or Daegu)

Job Description

Company Introduction
130여년 전 네덜란드에서 시작된 필립스는 헬스 테크놀로지 분야 선도 기업으로, 사람들이 더욱 건강한 삶과 웰빙(well-being)을 영위하도록 건강한 생활에서부터 질병의 예방, 조기 진단, 치료 과정 내 관리에 이르는 헬스케어 전 과정(Health Continuum)에서 전방위적 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다. 특히, 선진 기술력에 임상 및 소비자 분야에서 쌓은 인사이트를 더해 통합적인 솔루션을 제시하는데 주력하고 있습니다.

• Philips 채용 정보

• Philips - Better care for more people
• Why work at Philips?


Job Title: Clinical Application Specialist, IGT-S (Image Guided Therapy, Fixed Systems)

Location: This position will be based in either Busan or Daegu, depending on the candidate’s location. The work location may vary depending on business needs.

해당 포지션은 경상 지역 담당으로, 지원자의 거주지에 따라 부산 또는 대구에서 근무하게 됩니다. 업무상 필요 및 협의에 따라 근무지가 변경될 수 있습니다.


Role Summary:

As a Clinical Application Specialist IGT-S South Korea, you will provide clinical expertise through pre-sales presentations, product demonstrations, application training and handing over of company products. You will assist the sales staff in assessing potential application of company products to meet customer needs and preparing detailed product clinical specifications for the development and implementation of customer applications/solutions.


필립스코리아에서 IGT-S (Image Guided Therapy, Fixed Systems) 제품의 Clinical Application을 담당할 인재를 모집합니다. 본 포지션은 Philips IGT 제품/솔루션/서비스의 임상 응용에 대한 지식 전문가로서, 다양한 의료 환경에 맞춰 애플리케이션의 효과적인 적용과 통합을 지원합니다. 고객에게는 제품 프레젠테이션 및 데모 시연을 제공하고, 영업 팀에는 임상 관련 교육을 실시하여 고객 만족도 향상과 비즈니스 성장에 기여합니다. 또한, 복잡한 임상 워크플로우와 운영 절차를 분석해 비효율을 개선하고 제품 성능을 극대화합니다. 관련 규제 및 내부 기준을 철저히 준수하여 환자 안전을 보장하며, Philips 제품과 서비스의 성공적인 도입과 활용을 주도하는 핵심 역할을 수행합니다.


Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Support Account Managers by providing clinical decision support, including sales presentations, product demonstrations, and advising the sales force during customer acquisition; develop and execute winning clinical sales strategies to expand market share.
  • Actively participate with the sales team in clinical evaluations, product demonstrations and presentations; educate the sales team on emerging clinical issues and position solutions to address market changes.
  • Support new product launches. Stay up to date with new developments in the clinical application and operating field of the relevant equipment.
  • Conduct customer trainings and handover of newly installed IGT-S products or training for new end-users; set up application training schedules in close cooperation with customers.
  • Train customers in applying best possible clinical procedures and protocols to ensure optimal usage of delivered cathlabs, patient monitors and C-arm equipment; deliver customized (competency-based) training materials when required and support user group meetings.
  • Conduct regular customer visits to obtain direct feedback on training quality and customer satisfaction; report difficulties in optimal equipment usage and customer feedback to the IGT-S business unit in accordance with applicable quality standards, and follow up assigned quality & regulatory training in a timely manner.
  • Manage company safety standards, including radiation protection and health & safety regulations; take immediate control of hazards or accidents and involve the regional safety advisor when necessary; ensure all clinical applications training complies with the company’s quality policy.
  • As a Clinical Application Specialist IGT-S South Korea, be part of the APAC IGT-S Clinical Applications Specialist team and provide support to other countries outside of Korea when required.
  • Account Managers를 지원하여 제품 및 솔루션에 대한 임상적 의사결정 지원을 제공하고, 세일즈 프레젠테이션 및 제품 데모를 수행하며, 고객 확보 과정에서 세일즈 조직에 자문을 제공합니다. 또한 시장 점유율 확대를 위해 효과적인 임상 세일즈 전략을 수립하고 실행합니다.
  • 세일즈 팀과 협업하여 임상 평가, 제품 데모 및 프레젠테이션에 적극 참여하며, 세일즈 팀이 최신 임상 이슈를 이해할 수 있도록 교육하고 시장 변화에 대응할 수 있는 솔루션 포지셔닝을 지원합니다.
  • 신제품 런칭을 지원합니다. 또한 Angiography 제품 관련 임상 적용 및 운영 분야의 최신 동향을 지속적으로 모니터합니다.
  • 신규 설치된 IGT-S 제품 및 신규 사용자에 대한 고객 교육 및 인수인계를 수행하고, 고객과 긴밀히 협력하여 어플리케이션 트레이닝 일정을 수립합니다.
  • 고객이 제공된 Interventional imaging systems(Cathlabs, Patient monitors 및 C-arm 장비)를 최적으로 활용할 수 있도록 임상 절차와 프로토콜 적용 방법을 교육하며, 필요 시 커스터마이즈 된(competency-based) 교육 자료를 제공하고 사용자 그룹 미팅을 지원합니다.
  • 정기적인 고객 방문을 통해 교육 품질 및 고객 만족도에 대한 직접적인 피드백을 수집하며, 장비의 최적 사용과 관련된 이슈 및 고객 피드백을 관련 품질 기준에 따라 IGT-S 사업부에 보고하고, 지정된 품질 및 규제(Quality & Regulatory) 교육을 적시에 이수합니다.
  • 방사선 안전, 산업안전보건 규정을 포함한 회사의 안전 기준을 관리하며, 위험 상황 또는 사고 발생 시 즉각적으로 상황을 통제하고 Safety Advisor를 참여시킵니다. 또한 모든 임상 어플리케이션 교육이 회사의 품질 정책을 준수하도록 보장합니다.
  • Clinical Application Specialist IGT-S South Korea로서 APAC IGT-S Clinical Applications Specialist 팀의 일원으로 활동하며, 필요 시 타 국가의 IGT-S Clinical Application Specialist가 부재한 경우 한국 외 국가에 대한 지원을 수행합니다.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Graduated in radiology or related fields preferred.
  • Experience at Clinical applications or as a radiographer in a hospital setting preferred.
  • Experienced in Interventional procedure in hospital setting, Clinical Sales, Sales Support preferred.
  • Experience in Angiography, Image guided therapy product domain preferred.
  • Cathlab, C-arm and radiation safety in-depth knowledge, proficiency in one of the clinical segments such as Interventional Cardiology, Radiology, vascular, Neurology preferred.
  • Presentation, Demo skills, communication and follow up skills.
  • Ability to utilize problem-solving, critical thinking and priority-setting skills.
  • No obstacle to travel extensively within South Korea and within APAC when necessary.

  • Angiography 및 Image Guided Therapy 제품 분야 경험 보유자 우대
  • Cathlab, C-arm 및 방사선 안전 지식, Interventional Cardiology, Radiology, Vascular, Neurology 등 임상 세그먼트에 대한 경험 보유자 우대
  • 프레젠테이션 및 데모 역량, 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 팔로업 역량 보유
  • 문제 해결 능력, 비판적 사고 능력 및 우선순위 설정 능력 보유

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Accounts Receivable
jobs.description:
Alcon are one of Korea ‘Top Employer’s’ and are the market leader in eye care globally, helping people see better through advanced surgical and vision care products and if you want to help make a difference then please join us!

  

 

Major Accountabilities


Accounts Receivable and Credit Management

·         Manage accounts receivable risk through cash collection, account analysis, dispute resolution, and bad debt management.

·         Process credit approvals and regularly review customer credit limits, exposure, payment performance, and financial condition.

·         Manage collection activities for overdue accounts, including external collection and legal follow-up where applicable.

·         Manage complex and high-value customer accounts and provide reporting on outstanding balances, collection status, and credit exposure.

·         Ensure timely and accurate processing of customer payments, credit memos, and dispute resolution.

Business Partnership and Service Delivery

·         Partner with customers, Commercial Operations, and relevant teams to support effective accounts receivable management and issue resolution.

·         Coordinate with local, regional, global, and outsourced teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

·         Support AR Associates and relevant teams through knowledge sharing and operational guidance.

·         Drive process improvements and act as a system SME and Super User for accounts receivable processes.

Accounting, Reporting and Compliance

·         Perform month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, and account analysis, ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items.

·         Ensure accurate accounting and appropriate documentation of financial transactions.

·         Support internal and external audits, including documentation, inquiries, and follow-up actions.

·         Support accounting information required for corporate income tax adjustments and filings.

·         Ensure compliance with Alcon accounting and financial control policies, applicable regulations, and SOX requirements.


Qualification

·        Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. A professional accounting or finance qualification is preferred.

·        Proficiency in Korean and business-level English.

·        5–8 years of relevant finance/accounting experience.

·        Strong knowledge of AR, credit management, collections, and account reconciliation.

·        Good understanding of month-end closing and accounting principles.

·        SAP knowledge and audit/tax support experience are preferred.

·        Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
